title: Source Known Identifiers: A Three-Tier Identity System for Distributed Applications
comment: 22 pages, 3 figures, 11 tables, submitted to PeerJ
summary:
Distributed applications need identifiers that satisfy storage efficiency, chronological sortability, origin metadata embedding, zero-lookup verifiability, confidentiality for external consumers, and multi-century addressability. Based on our literature survey, no existing scheme provides all six of these identifier properties within a unified system.
  This paper introduces Source Known Identifiers (SKIDs), a three-tier identity system that projects a single entity identity across trust boundaries, addressing all six properties. The first tier, Source Known ID (SKID), is a 64-bit signed integer embedding a timestamp with a 250-millisecond precision, application topology, and a per-entity-type sequence counter. It serves as the database primary key, providing compact storage (8 bytes) and natural B-tree ordering for optimized database indexing. The second tier, Source Known Entity ID (SKEID), extends the SKID into a 128-bit Universally Unique Identifier (UUID) compatible value by adding an entity type discriminator, an epoch selector, and a BLAKE3 keyed message authentication code (MAC). SKEIDs enable zero-lookup verification of identifier origin, integrity, and entity type within trusted environments, with a big-endian byte layout that preserves chronological ordering in lexicographic UUID string comparisons. The third tier, Secure SKEID, encrypts the entire SKEID using AES-256 symmetric encryption as a single-block pseudorandom permutation, producing ciphertext indistinguishable from random bytes while remaining compatible with standard UUID data-type parsers in string representation. Deterministic bidirectional transformations connect all three tiers.

AI.tldr: 本文提出SKIDs三层次标识符系统，通过64位SKID、128位SKEID和加密Secure SKEID三层结构，同时满足分布式应用的存储效率、时间排序、来源验证和机密性六项需求，各层间支持确定性双向转换。
AI.motivation: 现有分布式标识符方案无法同时满足存储效率、时间排序、来源元数据嵌入、零查询验证、机密性和长期可寻址性六项核心需求
AI.method: 设计三层次身份系统：SKID(64位含时间戳+拓扑+序列号)→SKEID(128位UUID兼容+类型+时代+MAC)→Secure SKEID(AES-256加密密文)，各层支持确定性双向转换
AI.result: 系统同时满足全部六项标识符属性需求，各层保持互操作性，存储紧凑(8字节起)，支持数据库B-tree索引和UUID标准解析
AI.conclusion: SKIDs为分布式应用提供统一的标识符框架，在存储效率、时序排序、来源验证和机密性之间取得平衡，适用于跨信任边界的分布式数据库场景

title: From Skew to Symmetry: Node-Interconnect Multi-Path Balancing with Execution-time Planning for Modern GPU Clusters
summary: Modern GPU-based high-performance computing clusters offer unprecedented communication bandwidth through heterogeneous intra-node interconnects and inter-node networks. However, despite this high aggregate bandwidth, many real-world communication patterns fail to fully utilize the available hardware. Traffic skew often leads to situations where a small subset of links becomes oversaturated while others remain underutilized, resulting in congestion, latency spikes, and poor scalability. Existing communication frameworks such as NCCL and MPI with UCX typically rely on static fastest-path routing or hashing-based multi-rail striping, which leaves significant bandwidth unused when runtime traffic deviates from expected distributions. To address these limitations, we propose NIMBLE (Node-Interconnect Multi-path Balancing with Execution-time orchestration), a runtime communication orchestration system that dynamically redistributes traffic to balance link utilization across all available intra-node and inter-node paths. NIMBLE formulates this as a capacity-normalized minimum-congestion optimization problem and solves it efficiently using a multiplicative-weights algorithm. It further employs CUDA-aware GPU kernel-based RDMA pipelining to route traffic through intermediate GPUs and rail-matched NICs. The system is endpoint-driven, integrates transparently with existing communication libraries without requiring application changes, and preserves ordering, determinism, and low overhead. On H100-SXM4 nodes with fully connected NVLink and four NDR400 rails, NIMBLE achieves up to 2.3x higher intra-node bandwidth and 3.8x higher inter-node throughput compared to single-path baselines. It outperforms NCCL and MPI by up to 5.2x on skewed All-to-Allv workloads and 1.35x on end-to-end LLM MoE workloads, while matching baseline performance under balanced traffic.

AI.tldr: NIMBLE是一种GPU集群通信优化系统，通过动态流量调度和多路径负载均衡解决GPU集群中流量倾斜导致的链路利用率不足问题，在H100集群上最高可实现5.2倍性能提升。
AI.motivation: 现代GPU集群尽管具备高聚合带宽，但流量倾斜常导致部分链路过载而其他链路闲置，现有NCCL和MPI等框架依赖静态路由或简单哈希条带化，无法适应运行时流量分布变化，造成拥塞、延迟突增和可扩展性差。
AI.method: NIMBLE将问题建模为容量归一化最小拥塞优化问题，采用乘法权重算法高效求解；结合CUDA感知的GPU内核RDMA流水线技术，通过中间GPU和rail匹配的NIC路由流量；系统采用端点驱动架构，可透明集成到现有通信库，无需应用修改，同时保序、确定性和低开销。
AI.result: 在H100-SXM4节点（NVLink全互联+四NDR400 rail）上：节点内带宽提升2.3倍，节点间吞吐提升3.8倍；偏斜All-to-Allv工作负载下优于NCCL/MPI达5.2倍；LLM MoE端到端任务提升1.35倍；均衡流量下性能持平基线。
AI.conclusion: NIMBLE通过动态多路径流量调度有效解决了GPU集群通信中的流量倾斜问题，在各种工作负载下均展现出显著性能优势，同时保持了与现有系统的兼容性和确定性语义。

title: TENT: A Declarative Slice Spraying Engine for Performant and Resilient Data Movement in Disaggregated LLM Serving
summary: Modern GPU clusters are built upon a complex hierarchy of heterogeneous interconnects, ranging from multi-rail RDMA to proprietary fabrics such as Multi-Node NVLink and Ascend UB. Orchestrating these diverse links effectively remains a critical challenge in disaggregated LLM serving. Operating Mooncake TE on thousands of GPUs exposed a critical limitation shared by existing frameworks: imperative, statically bound path selection. This rigidity forces engines to rely on state-blind striping that ignores congestion signals, creating communication silos, wasting multi-rail bandwidth due to head-of-line blocking, and leading to operational fragility where routine faults require manual intervention. We present TENT, a data-movement engine that decouples transfer intent from physical execution. Instead of locking workloads to fixed backends, TENT unifies heterogeneous interconnects into a single dynamic resource pool. Applications simply declare transfer intents, while TENT dynamically decomposes elephant flows into fine-grained slices and "sprays" them across links based on instantaneous link quality. This telemetry-driven orchestration eliminates head-of-line blocking and enables transparent, sub-50 ms self-healing by rerouting slices around failures without application logic. TENT serves as the production data plane for LLM inference and RL pipelines at multiple industrial sites. Our evaluation on H800 HGX clusters shows that TENT outperforms state-of-the-art baselines, including Mooncake TE, NIXL, and UCCL. In LLM inference with SGLang HiCache, TENT achieves up to 1.36x higher throughput and 26% lower P90 TTFT than Mooncake TE. In RL pipelines, TENT accelerates parameter updates in Moonshot Checkpoint Engine by 20-26%.

AI.tldr: TENT是一个数据移动引擎，通过将传输意图与物理执行解耦，统一异构互连为动态资源池，实现基于实时链路质量的流量切片与动态路由，消除队头阻塞，支持亚50ms自愈，显著提升LLM推理和RL训练性能。
AI.motivation: 现有框架（如Mooncake TE）采用命令式、静态绑定的路径选择机制，存在三大核心问题：状态无关的条带化策略忽视拥塞信号、多轨道带宽因队头阻塞而浪费、故障恢复依赖手动干预。这些问题在千卡规模LLM服务场景下严重制约系统效率和稳定性。
AI.method: TENT提出传输意图与物理执行解耦的架构：应用层仅声明传输意图，引擎内部将大流分解为细粒度切片，基于实时链路质量在异构互连（多轨道RDMA、NVLink、Ascend UB等）间动态"喷洒"传输，同时内置透明自愈机制实现故障自动绕路。
AI.result: 在H800 HGX集群评估中，TENT全面超越Mooncake TE、NIXL、UCCL等SOTA基线。LLM推理场景下，结合SGLang HiCache实现1.36倍吞吐量和26%的P90 TTFT降低；RL训练场景下，Moonshot Checkpoint Engine参数更新加速20-26%。
AI.conclusion: TENT通过动态遥测驱动的编排策略，成功解决了异构互连场景下的通信效率与可靠性难题，已在多个工业站点完成生产部署验证，为LLM Serving数据平面提供了高效、弹性、自动化的大规模传输解决方案。

title: Reclaiming Idle CPU Cycles on Kubernetes: Sparse-Domain Multiplexing for Concurrent MPI-CFD Simulations
comment: 14 pages, 7 figures, 5 tables. Submitted to Future Generation Computer Systems
summary: When MPI-parallel simulations run on shared Kubernetes clusters, conventional CPU scheduling leaves the vast majority of provisioned cycles idle at synchronization barriers. This paper presents a multiplexing framework that reclaims this idle capacity by co-locating multiple simulations on the same cluster. PMPI-based duty-cycle profiling quantifies the per-rank idle fraction; proportional CPU allocation then allows a second simulation to execute concurrently with minimal overhead, yielding 1.77x throughput. A Pareto sweep to N=5 concurrent simulations shows throughput scaling to 3.74x, with a knee at N=3 offering the best efficiency-cost trade-off. An analytical model with a single fitted parameter predicts these gains within +/-4%. A dynamic controller automates the full pipeline, from profiling through In-Place Pod Vertical Scaling (KEP-1287) to packing and fairness monitoring, achieving 3.25x throughput for four simulations without manual intervention or pod restarts. To our knowledge, this is the first CPU application of In-Place Pod Vertical Scaling to running MPI processes. Experiments on an AWS cluster with OpenFOAM CFD confirm that the results hold under both concentric and standard graph-based (Scotch) mesh partitioning.

AI.tldr: 在共享Kubernetes集群上运行MPI并行模拟时，传统CPU调度导致大量周期在同步屏障处闲置。本文提出一个多路复用框架，通过在相同集群上共置多个模拟来回收这些空闲容量，实现1.77x-3.74x吞吐量提升，并首次将In-Place Pod Vertical Scaling应用于运行中的MPI进程。
AI.motivation: 在共享Kubernetes集群上运行MPI并行模拟时，传统的CPU调度方式导致大量已配置的CPU周期在同步屏障处处于空闲状态，造成严重的资源浪费。
AI.method: 1. 使用PMPI（过程间MPI）进行工作周期分析，量化每个进程的空闲比例；2. 基于比例的CPU分配允许第二个模拟并发执行；3. Pareto分析找到最优并发数量；4. 构建包含单个拟合参数的解析模型预测收益；5. 开发动态控制器自动化整个流程，包括profiling、In-Place Pod Vertical Scaling（KEP-1287）、打包和公平性监控。
AI.result: 静态配置下单模拟吞吐量提升1.77x，Pareto扫描到N=5个并发模拟时达3.74x，N=3为效率-成本最佳点；解析模型预测精度在±4%以内；动态控制器在无需人工干预或Pod重启的情况下，为四个并发模拟实现3.25x吞吐量提升。AWS集群上OpenFOAM CFD测试验证了该方法在同心分区和Scotch图分区下均有效。
AI.conclusion: 该框架首次成功将In-Place Pod Vertical Scaling应用于运行中的MPI进程，通过回收同步屏障处的空闲CPU周期，可显著提升共享Kubernetes集群上MPI模拟的吞吐量，且解析模型能够准确预测性能收益。

title: Secure Forgetting: A Framework for Privacy-Driven Unlearning in Large Language Model (LLM)-Based Agents
summary: Large language model (LLM)-based agents have recently gained considerable attention due to the powerful reasoning capabilities of LLMs. Existing research predominantly focuses on enhancing the task performance of these agents in diverse scenarios. However, as LLM-based agents become increasingly integrated into real-world applications, significant concerns emerge regarding their accumulation of sensitive or outdated knowledge. Addressing these concerns requires the development of mechanisms that allow agents to selectively forget previously learned knowledge, giving rise to a new term LLM-based agent unlearning. This paper initiates research on unlearning in LLM-based agents. Specifically, we propose a novel and comprehensive framework that categorizes unlearning scenarios into three contexts: state unlearning (forgetting specific states or items), trajectory unlearning (forgetting sequences of actions) and environment unlearning (forgetting entire environments or categories of tasks). Within this framework, we introduce a natural language-based unlearning method that trains a conversion model to transform high-level unlearning requests into actionable unlearning prompts, guiding agents through a controlled forgetting process. Moreover, to evaluate the robustness of the proposed framework, we introduce an unlearning inference adversary capable of crafting prompts, querying agents, and observing their behaviors in an attempt to infer the forgotten knowledge. Experimental results show that our approach effectively enables agents to forget targeted knowledge while preserving performance on untargeted tasks, and prevents the adversary from inferring the forgotten knowledge.

AI.tldr: 本文开创性地提出「LLM-based agent unlearning（LLM 智能体遗忘）」这一新研究方向：提出将遗忘请求划分为状态遗忘、轨迹遗忘、环境遗忘三类场景的框架，并训练一个转换模型，把高层自然语言遗忘请求翻译为可执行的遗忘提示（prompt），在不改动底层 LLM 参数的前提下通过「删记忆 + 行为约束」实现精准遗忘，同时保持非目标任务性能；并设计遗忘推断攻击者验证其不可被逆向重建。
AI.motivation: LLM 智能体被大量部署到真实场景后，会积累敏感或过期知识（如私人住所位置、健康相关行为轨迹、已停用区域结构），而《被遗忘权》等合规要求与安全需求提出了「可选择性遗忘」的新问题。已有研究存在三点不足：(1) LLM 遗忘的目标是移除模型内部知识，而实践中底层 LLM 参数往往不可修改，智能体的行为由 LLM 与用户提示共同驱动；(2) 强化学习遗忘（reinforcement unlearning）依赖直接改参数以改变动作选择概率，与非独立神经网络型智能体机制不同；(3) 缺少对智能体遗忘目标的明确形式化定义，且遗忘易引发灾难性遗忘，使智能体在无关任务上的性能下降。因此需要：（a）如何具体化智能体遗忘目标；（b）遗忘后如何维持未目标任务性能。
AI.method: 框架层面：提出三类遗忘场景及对应形式化目标——状态遗忘（清除记忆中相关状态，并使转移到该状态的概率为 0）、轨迹遗忘（清除轨迹记忆，禁止按既定顺序重演该轨迹，但允许单独访问其中各状态）、环境遗忘（清除该环境全部记忆，使该环境内奖励低于遗忘前、其余环境奖励不变）。执行层面：任何遗忘都靠两条互补机制——修改智能体记忆 Mem=(s,a,r) 与通过提示约束智能体行为。方法层面：以 GPT-Neo-2.7B 初始化转换模型 C，对每个遗忘请求 x 采样生成 m=3 个遗忘提示 y，用 LLM 指导智能体并按是否达成遗忘目标将提示标为 preferred/dispreferred，构造 p×q 偏好对数据集，再用 DPO 风格损失（含 KL 正则项，β 控制偏离基座程度）微调 C。理论上：从策略整形角度把提示变换 f 视为对策略的约束优化（使 π_θ(a|s;f(x))≈π_ref(a|s)，KL 距离 ≤ ε）；证明 Bradley–Terry 偏好假设下最优解 π*_φ(y|x) ∝ π_base(y|x)·exp(Q(x,y))；给出损失 L-光滑（引理1）与 α-强凸（引理2）条件，证明梯度下降线性收敛（定理1），并给出遗忘后行为分布与参考分布间 KL 上界 Lε（定理2），随训练 ε→0 说明行为不可区分。实验：GridWorld、AlfWorld、HotPotQA、HumanEval 四个平台，GPT-4o-mini/Claude-3-haiku/Llama-3.3-70B 三种 LLM，基线为 Code-based 与 Example-based 提示；指标为 unlearning efficacy、Unlearn@1、success rate 及步数；消融包括移除转换模型、取消微调、更换基座模型（Pythia-2.8B、GPT-2-Medium）、改变 m；另在 Gazebo 仿真平台做真实机器人验证，并用「遗忘推断攻击者」（状态/轨迹二元推断、环境重建攻击）做鲁棒性评估。
AI.result: 1) 效果：NL-based 方法在多数场景下 unlearning efficacy 与 Unlearn@1 最高（GridWorld 状态/轨迹遗忘 0.98–0.99，AlfWorld 多为 1.0；环境遗忘步数从约 20 增至 48–61，呈现"首次进入"的探索性行为），且未目标任务成功率基本不变；Code-based 略逊但仍稳健；Example-based 明显最差（例：AlfWorld 轨迹遗忘 Unlearn@1 仅 0.34–0.60，且成功率大幅下滑），原因是示例式提示缺少显式约束、易保留潜在关联。2) 鲁棒性：遗忘后智能体重访被遗忘状态/轨迹的概率与"从未见过"基线几乎相同（如 0.01–0.03 vs 0.01–0.02），环境重建成功率从约 96% 降至约 15%（基线约 14%），而 Code-based/Example-based 仍高达约 33%/43%。3) 消融：移除转换模型后各场景 unlearning efficacy 显著下降（如 AlfWorld 状态遗忘 1.0→0.71–0.84），仅取消微调的退化幅度较小，说明转换模型与其微调均必要；基座模型规模影响明显，Pythia-2.8B 与 GPT-Neo-2.7B 相当，GPT-2-Medium-345M 大幅下降；m=3 最佳，m=1 明显变差，m=5 边际提升有限。4) 模型差异与失败模式：Claude 对隐含语义（如"放入热水杯"隐含加热）理解不足，Unlearn@1 偏低；GPT 易"过度推理"（如把"放入微波炉"一律当作加热）导致过度遗忘；在 AlfWorld 中遗忘多个类别/环境时 GPT 与 Llama 出现 over-unlearning，成功率明显下降。5) 扩展性：遗忘 2–10 个状态/轨迹/环境仍保持高 efficacy，GridWorld 中目标环境步数随遗忘数量增加而上升（5 个约 25 步、10 个约 29 步），非目标环境步数保持稳定；Gazebo 仿真中机器人确实避开被遗忘的门、改走替代路线、环境遗忘后呈随机探索。
AI.conclusion: 本文确立了 LLM 智能体遗忘作为一个独立研究方向，贡献在于：（1）明确该问题与 LLM 遗忘、强化学习遗忘在目标层级上的差异（调控行为而非修改参数）；（2）提出状态/轨迹/环境三类遗忘场景的分类与形式化问题定义；（3）提出以自然语言为媒介、经偏好优化训练的转换模型，把高层遗忘请求转为可执行遗忘提示，配合记忆擦除实现不改动 LLM 参数的精准遗忘，并从策略整形角度给出效用、收敛性与行为分布 KL 鲁棒性的理论保证；（4）通过多平台、多 LLM 实验、消融、扩展性与 Gazebo 仿真，以及专门的遗忘推断/环境重建攻击者，证明该方法在遗忘目标知识的同时保持无关任务效用，且使被遗忘内容在行为层面不可被逆向推断。局限与后续方向：不同 LLM 在语义理解与过度遗忘上差异明显，多目标同时遗忘时存在性能损失，且受限于只能通过提示层行为间接遗忘；未来工作将扩展到多智能体系统等更具交互性的真实场景。

title: Quantifying Confidence in Assurance 2.0 Arguments
summary:
Confidence is central to safety and assurance cases: how much confidence a decision requires and how much the argument actually provides are both important questions. We present a new method for assessing probabilistic confidence in assurance case arguments that is simple, systematic and sound.
  It exploits the ways claims are decomposed in a structured argument and provides different approaches according to the different degrees of (in)dependence and diversity among subclaims and the way they eliminate concerns that undermine confidence in their parent claims. The method uses only elementary probabilistic constructions that are well-known in other contexts (e.g., Frechet bounds) but we interpret and apply them in a manner that is specifically focused on assurance arguments and requires no background in probabilistic analysis.
  We show that the method is not susceptible to the counterexamples that Graydon and Holloway exhibit for other approaches to confidence and we recommend it as an additional tool in evaluation of Assurance 2.0 arguments. The primary evaluation criteria for Assurance 2.0 remain logical indefeasibility and dialectical examination, but probabilistic assessment can be useful in evaluating cost/confidence tradeoffs for different risk levels, and the overall balance of confidence across a structured argument.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种简单、系统且健全的评估保障案例论证中概率置信度的新方法，通过利用结构化论证中声明分解的方式，根据子声明之间的（不）独立性和多样性程度提供不同方法，使用Frechet边界等基本概率构造，无需概率论背景即可应用。
AI.motivation: 置信度是安全与保障案例的核心要素，决策所需的置信度与论证实际提供的置信度之间存在重要关系。现有方法存在缺陷（Graydon和Holloway已发现反例），需要一种更简单、系统且健全的置信度评估方法。
AI.method: 该方法利用结构化论证中声明分解的特性，根据子声明间的（不）独立性和多样性程度以及消除损害父声明置信度关切的方式，提供差异化方法。核心采用Frechet边界等 elementary probabilistic constructions，并针对保障论证场景进行专门解释，使不具备概率分析背景的用户也能使用。
AI.result: 该方法能够规避Graydon和Holloway针对其他方法所指出的反例问题，证明了方法的健全性。
AI.conclusion: 该方法被推荐作为保障2.0（Assurance 2.0）论证评估的补充工具。保障2.0的主要评估标准仍为逻辑不可废止性和辩证审查，但概率评估可用于评估不同风险等级的成本/置信度权衡，以及结构化论证中置信度的整体平衡。

title: Fiber-Navigable Search: A Geometric Approach to Filtered ANN
summary: We present a geometric framework for filtered approximate nearest neighbor (ANN) search. Filtering a proximity graph by a metadata predicate produces a subgraph, a fiber, whose connectivity and geometry can differ sharply from the full graph. Using local signals, we propose a two-phase search algorithm that combines full-graph exploration with filtered-neighbor descent when the local geometry is favorable. These signals also classify search failures into three regimes: topological cuts, geometric folds, and genuine basins. A key observation is that all three share a common resolution: restarting the search in a fiber-present cluster near the query. To support this, we introduce a lightweight anchor structure that identifies such regions and restarts the search accordingly. We show empirically that the method outperforms FAISS HNSW on filtered search and the three failure regimes separate cleanly and shift predictably with filter selectivity.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种用于过滤式近似最近邻（ANN）搜索的几何框架，通过分析过滤后子图（fiber）的几何特性，设计两阶段搜索算法，并识别三种搜索失败模式（拓扑切割、几何折叠、真实盆地），通过锚点结构实现失败恢复。
AI.motivation: 过滤操作会显著改变图的连通性和几何结构，导致传统ANN方法性能下降。现有方法未能充分考虑过滤后子图的独特几何特性。
AI.method: 提出两阶段搜索算法：结合全图探索与过滤邻域下降。利用局部信号分类搜索失败为三种模式，并引入轻量级锚点结构识别适合重启的fiber-present聚类区域。
AI.result: 方法在过滤搜索任务上优于FAISS HNSW。三种失败模式能够清晰分离且随过滤选择性可预测转移。
AI.conclusion: 通过几何视角理解过滤ANN搜索问题，统一的重启策略可有效解决不同类型的搜索失败，为过滤搜索提供了理论框架和实用方案。

title: Two-Stage Optimizer-Aware Online Data Selection for Large Language Models
summary: Gradient-based data selection offers a principled framework for estimating sample utility in large language model (LLM) fine-tuning, but existing methods are mostly designed for offline settings. They are therefore less suited to online fine-tuning, where data arrives sequentially, sample utility is step-dependent, and the effective update geometry is shaped by adaptive optimizers. We propose an optimizer-aware framework for gradient-based online data selection and reweighting in LLM fine-tuning. Our key idea is to view online selection not as static sample ranking, but as shaping the next target-oriented update under the optimizer state. We formulate this as an optimizer-aware update-matching problem, establish its connection to second-order target utility, and show why subset-level construction must account for interactions and redundancy among selected samples. Based on this view, we develop a two-stage Filter-then-Weight algorithm that first filters geometrically useful candidates and then optimizes their coefficients. To make the framework practical for LLMs, we introduce a factorized outer-product gradient representation and optimized matrix computations for long-context data. Experiments show that our method consistently improves convergence and downstream performance over existing online data selection baselines under the same data budget.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种面向 LLM 在线微调的优化器感知梯度数据选择与重加权框架，将在线选择建模为优化器状态下的更新匹配问题，并设计了 Filter-then-Weight 两阶段算法，在长上下文数据场景下通过分解外积梯度表示提升效率。
AI.motivation: 现有基于梯度的数据选择方法主要针对离线场景设计，难以适应 LLM 在线微调中数据顺序到达、样本效用随训练步变化、以及自适应优化器塑造更新几何的动态特性。现有方法缺乏对优化器状态的显式建模，导致在在线设置下表现受限。
AI.method: (1) 将在线数据选择形式化为优化器感知的目标更新匹配问题，建立其与二阶目标效用的理论联系；(2) 证明子集层面的构建必须考虑样本间的交互与冗余；(3) 设计两阶段 Filter-then-Weight 算法：先过滤几何上有用的候选样本，再优化其系数；(4) 为适配 LLM 引入分解外积梯度表示与优化的矩阵计算以处理长上下文数据。
AI.result: 实验表明，在相同数据预算下，该方法相比现有在线数据选择基线方法持续提升了收敛速度和下游任务性能。
AI.conclusion: 通过将优化器状态纳入数据选择决策，所提框架能更有效地在在线微调场景下识别高价值样本，为 LLM 高效数据选择提供了兼具理论依据和实践可行性的新范式。

title: How Emotion Shapes the Behavior of LLMs and Agents: A Mechanistic Study
summary: Emotion plays an important role in human cognition and performance. Motivated by this, we investigate whether analogous emotional signals can shape the behavior of large language models (LLMs) and agents. Existing emotion-aware studies mainly treat emotion as a surface-level style factor or a perception target, overlooking its mechanistic role in task processing. To address this limitation, we propose E-STEER, an interpretable emotion steering framework that enables direct representation-level intervention in LLMs and agents. It embeds emotion as a structured, controllable variable in hidden states, and with it, we examine the impact of emotion on objective reasoning, subjective generation, safety, and multi-step agent behaviors. The results reveal non-monotonic emotion-behavior relations consistent with established psychological theories, and show that specific emotions not only enhance LLM capability but also improve safety, and systematically shape multi-step agent behaviors.

AI.tldr: 本文提出E-STEER框架，一种可解释的情绪引导框架，通过在LLM和智能体的隐藏状态中嵌入结构化、可控的情绪变量，实现对模型的直接表示层干预。研究发现情绪与行为之间存在非单调关系，特定情绪不仅能提升LLM能力，还能改善安全性，并系统性地影响多步骤智能体行为。
AI.motivation: 现有情绪感知研究主要将情绪视为表面层风格因素或感知目标，忽略了情绪在任务处理中的机制性作用。本文旨在探索类似人类的情绪信号是否能影响LLM和智能体的行为。
AI.method: E-STEER框架通过以下方式实现情绪干预：（1）在隐藏状态中将情绪嵌入为结构化、可控的变量；（2）实现直接表示层干预；（3）在客观推理、主观生成、安全性和多步骤智能体行为等多个维度进行评估。
AI.result: 实验揭示了情绪与行为之间存在符合经典心理学理论的非单调关系；特定情绪不仅能提升LLM能力，还能改善安全性；情绪会系统性影响多步骤智能体行为。
AI.conclusion: 情绪可作为有效杠杆同时提升LLM的能力和安全性，且其作用机制与人类心理学理论一致，为构建更具人类智能特征的AI系统提供了新思路。

title: MPI-Q: A Message Communication Library for Large-Scale Classical-Quantum Heterogeneous Hybrid Distributed Computing
summary:
The classical-quantum system heterogeneity (different data characteristics, execution paradigms and synchronization mechanism etc.) renders existing distributed communication mechanisms (e.g. MPI, NCCL etc.) inadequate. This bottleneck severely impairs operational synergy and programming efficiency. Thus, the performance of hybrid applications on classical-quantum heterogeneous infrastructures is directly limited.
  To address these challenges, this paper proposes a message-passing library tailored for large-scale classical-quantum heterogeneous distributed computing, referred to as MPI-Q. The design centers on three mechanisms. First, it defines a heterogeneous hybrid communication domain that achieves unified management of classical and quantum processes in heterogeneous hybrid systems. Second, it uses a lightweight communication path that allows classical control nodes to send device-ready waveform data directly to quantum MonitorProcesses, avoiding unnecessary relay stages. Third, it establishes a heterogeneous hybrid synchronization mechanism to tackle the problem of timing control for multi-node quantum operations. While retaining the traditional MPI programming model, MPI-Q achieves extension toward quantum subsystems. Experiments on distributed GHZ state preparation demonstrate that this model exhibits near-linear scalability, achieving a maximum speedup of 18.76 times on 24 quantum nodes. This proves that the library can effectively support large-scale heterogeneous hybrid distributed computing applications, filling the technical gap in this field.

AI.tldr: 针对经典-量子异构分布式系统中现有通信机制（如MPI、NCCL）的不足，提出MPI-Q消息传递库，通过异构混合通信域、 lightweight通信路径和异构混合同步机制三大设计，实现对量子子系统的扩展支持，在24量子节点上实现18.76倍加速，验证了大规模异构混合分布式计算的可行性。
AI.motivation: 经典-量子系统异构性（数据特征、执行范式、同步机制等差异）导致现有分布式通信机制（如MPI、NCCL）无法有效支持，限制了混合应用的操作协同和编程效率。
AI.method: 提出针对大规模经典-量子异构分布式计算的消息传递库MPI-Q，包含三个核心机制：1）定义异构混合通信域，实现经典和量子进程的统一管理；2）采用lightweight通信路径，允许经典控制节点直接将设备就绪的波形数据发送给量子MonitorProcess，避免不必要的 relay 阶段；3）建立异构混合同步机制，解决多节点量子操作的时序控制问题。
AI.result: 在分布式GHZ态制备实验中，该模型展现出近线性可扩展性，在24个量子节点上实现最大18.76倍加速。
AI.conclusion: MPI-Q能有效支持大规模异构混合分布式计算应用，填补了该领域的技术空白，同时保持了传统MPI编程模型的兼容性。

title: Internal State-Based Policy Gradient Methods for Partially Observable Markov Potential Games
comment: 6 pages, 2 figures. Submitted to IEEE Control Systems Letters (L-CSS) with CDC option
summary: This letter studies multi-agent reinforcement learning in partially observable Markov potential games. Solving this problem is challenging due to partial observability, decentralized information, and the curse of dimensionality. First, to address the first two challenges, we leverage the common information framework, which allows agents to act based on both shared and local information. Second, to ensure tractability, we study an internal state that compresses accumulated information, preventing it from growing unboundedly over time. We then implement an internal state-based natural policy gradient method to find Nash equilibria of the Markov potential game. Our main contribution is to establish a non-asymptotic convergence bound for this method. Our theoretical bound decomposes into two interpretable components: a statistical error term that also arises in standard Markov potential games, and an approximation error capturing the use of finite-state controllers. Finally, simulations across multiple partially observable environments demonstrate that the proposed method using finite-state controllers achieves consistent improvements in performance compared to the setting where only the current observation is used.

AI.tldr: 本文研究部分可观测马尔可夫潜在博弈中的多智能体强化学习问题，通过结合公共信息框架与内部状态压缩机制，利用有限状态控制器实现了一种内部状态-based自然策略梯度方法，并建立了该方法的非渐近收敛界。
AI.motivation: 多智能体强化学习在部分可观测环境中面临三大挑战：部分可观测性、分散信息结构以及维度灾难。现有方法难以有效处理这些问题，因此需要新的理论框架和算法设计。
AI.method: 1. 利用公共信息框架(Common Information Framework)使智能体能够基于共享信息和本地信息进行决策；2. 引入内部状态压缩累积信息，防止状态空间随时间无限增长；3. 采用基于内部状态的自然策略梯度方法求解马尔可夫潜在博弈的纳什均衡。
AI.result: 建立了该方法的非渐近收敛界，该界由两部分组成：标准马尔可夫潜在博弈中的统计误差项，以及使用有限状态控制器引入的近似误差项。
AI.conclusion: 仿真实验表明，在多个部分可观测环境中，基于有限状态控制器的所提方法相比仅使用当前观测的设置能够获得一致的性能提升，验证了内部状态压缩机制的有效性。

title: Large Language Models for Analyzing Enterprise Architecture Debt in Unstructured Documentation
comment: Author version, 2 figures, 5 tables. To appear in the Proceedings of the 41st ACM/SIGAPP Symposium on Applied Computing (SAC '26), 2026
summary: Enterprise Architecture Debt (EA Debt) arises from suboptimal design decisions and misaligned components that can degrade an organization's IT landscape over time. Early indicators, Enterprise Architecture Smells (EA Smells), are currently mainly detected manually or only from structured artifacts, leaving much unstructured documentation under-analyzed. This study proposes an approach using a large language model (LLM) to identify and quantify EA Debt in unstructured architectural documentation. Following a design science research approach, we design and evaluate an LLM-based prototype for automated EA Smell detection. The artifact ingests unstructured documents (e.g., process descriptions, strategy papers), applies fine-tuned detection models, and outputs identified smells. We evaluate the prototype through a case study using synthetic yet realistic business documents, benchmarking against a custom GPT-based model. Results show that LLMs can detect multiple predefined EA Smells in unstructured text, with the benchmark model achieving higher precision and processing speed, and the fine-tuned on-premise model offering data protection advantages. The findings highlight opportunities for integrating LLM-based smell detection into EA governance practice.

AI.tldr: 本研究提出使用大型语言模型（LLM）从非结构化架构文档中自动检测企业架构气味（EA Smells），以识别企业架构债务（EA Debt）。通过设计科学研究方法，开发并评估了一个基于LLM的原型系统。
AI.motivation: 当前EA Smells检测主要依赖人工方式或仅分析结构化工件，导致大量非结构化文档（如流程描述、战略文档等）未被充分利用，无法及时发现因设计决策不当和组件错位导致的架构债务问题。
AI.method: 采用设计科学研究方法，设计并开发了LLM原型系统。系统接收非结构化文档输入，通过微调的检测模型识别EA Smells并输出结果。研究使用合成但真实的业务文档进行案例研究，并将自定义GPT模型作为基准进行对比评估。
AI.result: 实验结果表明LLM能够从非结构化文本中检测多种预定义的EA Smells。基准GPT模型在精确率和处理速度上表现更优，而本地部署的微调模型则在数据保护方面具有优势。
AI.conclusion: LLM驱动的EA Smell检测技术具有良好的应用前景，可有效集成到企业架构治理实践中，帮助组织更全面地识别和量化架构债务。

title: Reasoning about Transactional Isolation Levels with Isolde
summary:
Most databases can be configured to operate under isolation levels weaker than serializability. These enforce fewer restrictions on the concurrent access to data and consequently allow for more performant implementations. While formal frameworks for rigorously specifying isolation levels exist, reasoning about the semantic differences between specifications remains notoriously difficult.
  This paper proposes a tool -- Isolde -- that can automatically generate examples that are allowed by an isolation level but disallowed by another. This simple primitive unlocks a range of useful reasoning tasks, including checking equivalence between definitions, and verifying (by refutation) subtle semantic properties of isolation levels. For example, Isolde allowed us to easily and automatically reproduce a famously elusive result from the literature and to discover a previously unknown bug in the alternative specification of a standard isolation level used in a state-of-the-art isolation checker.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Isolde工具，能够自动生成区分不同数据库隔离级别的反例，支持定义等价性检查和属性验证，并成功复现了经典结论且发现了现有规范中的未知bug。
AI.motivation: 尽管数据库隔离级别的形式化框架已经存在，但理解和比较不同规范之间的语义差异仍然非常困难。现有方法缺乏有效工具来直观展示隔离级别间的细微差别。
AI.method: Isolde工具通过自动生成"某隔离级别允许但另一隔离级别不允许"的执行示例，作为核心原语来区分不同隔离级别。该方法可应用于检查定义等价性、验证（通过反驳）隔离级别的语义属性。
AI.result: Isolde能够轻松自动地复现文献中著名的难觅结论，并在最先进的隔离级别检查器的替代规范中发现了一个此前未知的bug，验证了其有效性和实用价值。
AI.conclusion: 该工具为隔离级别研究提供了有效的自动化验证手段，证明了自动生成反例在形式化验证中的实用价值，为隔离级别的规范开发和验证开辟了新途径。

title: Task-Centric Personalized Federated Fine-Tuning of Language Models
summary: Federated Learning (FL) has emerged as a promising technique for training language models on distributed and private datasets of diverse tasks. However, aggregating models trained on heterogeneous tasks often degrades the overall performance of individual clients. To address this issue, Personalized FL (pFL) aims to create models tailored for each client's data distribution. Although these approaches improve local performance, they usually lack robustness in two aspects: (i) generalization: when clients must make predictions on unseen tasks, or face changes in their data distributions, and (ii) intra-client tasks interference: when a single client's data contains multiple distributions that may interfere with each other during local training. To tackle these two challenges, we propose FedRouter, a clustering-based pFL that builds specialized models for each task rather than for each client. FedRouter uses adapters to personalize models by employing two clustering mechanisms to associate adapters with specific tasks. A local clustering that associate adapters with task data samples and a global one that associates similar adapters from different clients to construct task-centric personalized models. Additionally, we propose an evaluation router mechanism that routes test samples to the best adapter based on the created clusters. Experiments comparing our method with existing approaches across a multitask dataset, FedRouter demonstrate strong resilience in these challenging scenarios performing up to 6.1% relatively better under tasks interference and up to 136% relative improvement under generalization evaluation.

AI.tldr: FedRouter是一种基于聚类的个性化联邦学习框架，通过适配器为每个任务（而非每个客户端）构建专业化模型，解决异构任务聚合时的性能下降、泛化能力不足和任务干扰问题，在任务干扰场景下提升6.1%，泛化评估中提升136%。
AI.motivation: 联邦学习在聚合异构任务的模型时往往导致各客户端性能下降；现有个性化联邦学习方法缺乏鲁棒性，主要体现在两方面：(1)泛化能力弱——面对未见任务或数据分布变化时表现差；(2)任务干扰问题——单个客户端数据含多种分布，本地训练时相互干扰。
AI.method: 提出FedRouter框架，采用双层聚类机制：(1)本地聚类——将适配器与任务数据样本关联；(2)全局聚类——聚合不同客户端的相似适配器构建以任务为中心的个性化模型。同时设计评估路由机制，根据聚类结果将测试样本路由至最优适配器。
AI.result: FedRouter在多任务数据集上表现优异：任务干扰场景下相对提升6.1%，泛化评估中相对提升136%。
AI.conclusion: FedRouter通过任务中心化而非客户端中心化的个性化策略，有效解决了异构联邦学习中的泛化性和任务干扰问题，为分布式隐私保护环境下的多任务学习提供了更鲁棒的解决方案。

title: One Panel Does Not Fit All: Case-Adaptive Multi-Agent Deliberation for Clinical Prediction
summary: Large language models applied to clinical prediction exhibit case-level heterogeneity: simple cases yield consistent outputs, while complex cases produce divergent predictions under minor prompt changes. Existing single-agent strategies sample from one role-conditioned distribution, and multi-agent frameworks use fixed roles with flat majority voting, discarding the diagnostic signal in disagreement. We propose CAMP (Case-Adaptive Multi-agent Panel), where an attending-physician agent dynamically assembles a specialist panel tailored to each case's diagnostic uncertainty. Each specialist evaluates candidates via three-valued voting (KEEP/REFUSE/NEUTRAL), enabling principled abstention outside one's expertise. A hybrid router directs each diagnosis through strong consensus, fallback to the attending physician's judgment, or evidence-based arbitration that weighs argument quality over vote counts. On diagnostic prediction and brief hospital course generation from MIMIC-IV across four LLM backbones, CAMP consistently outperforms strong baselines while consuming fewer tokens than most competing multi-agent methods, with voting records and arbitration traces offering transparent decision audits.

AI.tldr: CAMP通过动态组建专家小组解决临床预测中复杂病例预测分歧问题，采用三值投票机制(KEEP/REFINE/NEUTRAL)和混合路由策略实现自适应诊断，在MIMIC-IV数据集上验证了方法的有效性。
AI.motivation: 大型语言模型在临床预测中存在病例级别的异质性问题：简单病例输出一致，复杂病例在微小提示变化下产生分歧。现有单智能体策略采样单一角色分布，多智能体框架使用固定角色和平等投票，丢弃了分歧中的诊断信号。
AI.method: CAMP框架包含三个核心组件：(1)主诊医师智能体根据病例诊断不确定性动态组建专科医师小组；(2)三值投票机制(KEEP/REFUSE/NEUTRAL)支持专家在专业范围外原则性弃权；(3)混合路由器将诊断流程导向三种路径——强共识路径、回落主诊医师判断、或基于论证质量的证据仲裁。
AI.result: 在MIMIC-IV数据集上使用四种LLM后端进行诊断预测和住院病程生成实验，CAMP一致优于强基线方法，且 token 消耗低于大多数竞争性多智能体方法。
AI.conclusion: CAMP通过案例自适应策略和透明决策审计机制，在保持可解释性的同时提升了临床预测的准确性和鲁棒性，为多智能体医疗AI系统提供了新的设计范式。

title: Is RISC-V Ready for Machine Learning? Portable Gaussian Processes Using Asynchronous Tasks
comment: 12 pages, 4 figures, 1 table, submitted to the International Workshop on RISC-V for HPC at ISC
summary:
Gaussian processes are widely used in machine learning domains but remain computationally demanding, limiting their efficient scalability across diverse hardware platforms. The GPRat library targets these challenges with the help of the asynchronous many-task runtime system HPX. In this work, we extend GPRat to enable portability across multiple hardware architectures and evaluate its performance on representative x86-64, ARM, and RISC-V chips. We conduct node-level strong-scaling and problem-size-scaling benchmarks for Gaussian Process prediction and hyperparameter optimization to assess single-core performance, parallel scalability, and architectural efficiency.
  Our results show that while the x86-64 Zen 2 chip achieves a 58% single-core performance advantage over the ARM-based Fujitsu A64FX, superior parallel scaling allows the 48-core ARM chip to outperform the 64-core Zen 2 by 9% at full node utilization. The evaluated SOPHON SG2042 RISC-V chip exhibits substantially lower performance and weaker scalability, with single-core performance lagging by up to a factor of 14 and large-scale parallel workloads showing slowdowns of up to a factor of 25. For problem-size scaling, ARM and x86-64 systems demonstrate comparable performance within 25%. These findings highlight the growing competitiveness of ARM-based processors and emphasize the importance of wide-register vectorization support and memory subsystem improvements for upcoming RISC-V platforms.

AI.tldr: 本文评估了基于HPX异步运行时系统的GPRat高斯过程计算库在x86-64 (Zen 2)、ARM (A64FX) 和RISC-V (SG2042) 三种硬件架构上的性能表现。研究表明ARM芯片凭借更好的并行扩展性在多核场景下超越x86-64，而RISC-V芯片因向量化和内存子系统限制表现欠佳。
AI.motivation: 高斯过程计算在大规模机器学习应用中面临计算密集型挑战，需要在多样化硬件平台上实现高效可扩展的部署，现有方案缺乏跨架构的便携性和并行效率评估。
AI.method: 使用HPX异步多任务运行时系统扩展GPRat库，开展节点级强扩展性测试和问题规模扩展性测试，在三种代表性芯片上进行单核性能、并行扩展性和架构效率的综合评估。
AI.result: x86-64 Zen 2单核性能比ARM A64FX高58%，但ARM的48核配置凭借更优并行扩展性在满节点时比64核Zen 2快9%。RISC-V SG2042单核性能落后达14倍，大规模并行工作负载减速达25倍。问题规模扩展测试中，ARM与x86-64性能差距在25%以内。
AI.conclusion: ARM处理器在并行计算场景中竞争力日益增强，RISC-V平台需重点改进宽寄存器向量化支持和内存子系统性能以提升竞争力。

title: CASCADE: Cascaded Scoped Communication for Multi-Agent Re-planning in Disrupted Industrial Environments
comment: Published at ICLR 2026 Workshop on AI for Mechanism Design and Strategic Decision Making
summary: Industrial disruption replanning demands multi-agent coordination under strict latency and communication budgets, where disruptions propagate through tightly coupled physical dependencies and rapidly invalidate baseline schedules and commitments. Existing coordination schemes often treat communication as either effectively free (broadcast-style escalation) or fixed in advance (hand-tuned neighborhoods), both of which are brittle once the disruption footprint extends beyond a local region. We present \CASCADE, a budgeted replanning mechanism that makes communication scope explicit and auditable rather than fixed or implicit. Each agent maintains an explicit knowledge base, solves role-conditioned local decision problems to revise commitments, and coordinates through lightweight contract primitives whose footprint expands only when local validation indicates that the current scope is insufficient. This design separates a unified agent substrate (Knowledge Base / Decision Manager / Communication Manager) from a scoped interaction layer that controls who is contacted, how far coordination propagates, and when escalation is triggered under explicit budgets. We evaluate \CASCADE on disrupted manufacturing and supply-chain settings using unified diagnostics intended to test a mechanism-design claim -- whether explicit scope control yields useful quality-latency-communication trade-offs and improved robustness under uncertainty -- rather than to provide a complete algorithmic ranking.

AI.tldr: CASCADE是一种具有显式预算控制的多智能体重规划机制，通过知识库/决策管理器/通信管理器分离设计，在通信范围不足时动态扩展协调范围，解决工业 disruptions 下多智能体协调的延迟和通信开销问题。
AI.motivation: 现有协调方案将通信视为"免费"（广播式升级）或"固定"（预设邻域），在 disruptions 影响范围超出局部区域时表现脆弱。需要在严格延迟和通信预算约束下实现多智能体协调。
AI.method: CASCADE采用模块化设计：(1) 知识库维护显式知识表示；(2) 决策管理器通过角色条件化局部决策问题修订承诺；(3) 通信管理器使用轻量级契约原语，其作用范围仅在本地验证不足时扩展。通过作用域控制层明确管理"联系谁、协调传播多远、何时触发升级"。
AI.result: 在制造业和供应链 disruptions 场景下验证了显式作用域控制机制设计的有效性，证明其能够实现有意义的"质量-延迟-通信"权衡，并在不确定性下保持鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: 将通信范围从隐式/固定转变为显式和可审计的设计选择，能够在工业 disruption replanning 场景中实现更灵活、更鲁棒的协调机制。

title: The Energy Footprint of LLM-Based Environmental Analysis: LLMs and Domain Products
summary: As large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used in domain-specific applications, including climate change and environmental research, understanding their energy footprint has become an important concern. The growing adoption of retrieval-augmented (RAG) systems for climate-domain specific analysis raises a key question: how does the energy consumption of domain-specific RAG workflows compare with that of direct generic LLM usage? Prior research has focused on standalone model calls or coarse token-based estimates, while leaving the energy implications of deployed application workflows insufficiently understood. In this paper, we assess the inference-time energy consumption of two LLM-based climate analysis chatbots (ChatNetZero and ChatNDC) compared to the generic GPT-4o-mini model. We estimate energy use under actual user queries by decomposing each workflow into retrieval, generation, and hallucination-checking components. We also test across different times of day and geographic access locations. Our results show that the energy consumption of domain-specific RAG systems depends strongly on their design. More agentic pipelines substantially increase inference-time energy use, particularly when used for additional accuracy or verification checks, although they may not yield proportional gains in response quality. While more research is needed to further test these initial findings more robustly across models, environments and prompting structures, this study provides a new understanding on how the design of domain-specific LLM products affects both the energy footprint and quality of output.

AI.tldr: 本文评估了基于LLM的气候分析聊天机器人（ChatNetZero和ChatNDC）与通用GPT-4o-mini模型的推理时能耗，对比了RAG系统与直接使用通用LLM的能耗差异，发现更"智能化"的RAG系统设计会显著增加能耗，但不一定带来相应的输出质量提升。
AI.motivation: 随着LLM在气候与环境研究等特定领域的应用增长，理解其能源足迹变得至关重要。检索增强生成（RAG）系统在气候领域的广泛采用引发了一个关键问题：领域特定RAG工作流程的能耗与传统直接使用通用LLM相比如何？现有研究主要关注独立模型调用或粗略的token估算，对已部署应用工作流程的能源影响理解不足。
AI.method: 将每个RAG工作流程分解为检索、生成和幻觉检查三个组件，在不同时间段和地理访问位置下，使用实际用户查询来估算能耗。
AI.result: 领域特定RAG系统的能耗高度依赖于其设计。更智能化的管道会显著增加推理时能耗，特别是在用于额外准确性或验证检查时，尽管可能不会带来与能耗增加成正比的响应质量提升。
AI.conclusion: RAG系统的设计对LLM产品的能源足迹和输出质量都有显著影响，但需要进一步在不同模型、环境和提示结构下进行更稳健的验证。

title: The Data Hydration Gap: A Formal Model of Underinvestment in General-Purpose Data Products Under Decentralized Governance
summary: When organizations decentralize data product ownership, as in the data mesh paradigm, each domain team optimizes for its immediate analytical needs, underinvesting in the cross-domain generality that enables organization-wide reuse. We formalize this as a simultaneous-move game in which N domains choose quality (q) and generality (g). Generality creates positive externalities but is privately costly. The Nash equilibrium generality gap is increasing in the number of domains and the value of cross-domain analytics. Under plausible parameter configurations, a corner solution obtains in which no reusable silver layer emerges organically, a condition we term the data mesh trap. Technical debt from narrow products grows quadratically in N. An illustrative calibration suggests non-trivial organizational welfare losses under plausible enterprise parameters. We derive within-model conditions under which centralized, federated, and hybrid governance regimes dominate, and we identify the information asymmetries and transaction costs that complicate implementation. The model provides a formal foundation for empirical research on decentralized data governance.

AI.tldr: 论文研究了数据网格范式下的治理困境：将数据产品所有权去中心化后，各领域团队仅优化自身分析需求，导致跨域复用性投资不足。作者将其建模为N个领域同时选择质量(q)和通用性(g)的博弈，证明纳什均衡的通用性缺口随领域数量和跨域分析价值增加而扩大，在某些参数配置下会出现"数据网格陷阱"——即没有可复用的银层自然产生，技术债以N²速度增长。
AI.motivation: 数据网格范式中，去中心化数据所有权导致各领域团队仅关注自身即时分析需求，对创造跨域复用的通用性投入不足，形成负和博弈。缺乏形式化框架来理解不同治理模式（中心化、联邦式、混合式）的适用条件和权衡。
AI.method: 将跨域数据治理投资问题形式化为同时行动博弈：N个领域同时选择质量(q)和通用性(g)，其中通用性产生正外部性但对个体而言成本高昂。通过求解纳什均衡、分析比较静态效应、进行校准估算来评估均衡结果。
AI.result: 纳什均衡的通用性缺口随领域数量N和跨域分析价值单调递增；存在"数据网格陷阱"——无 reusable silver layer 自行产生的角点解；技术债以N²速度增长；在合理企业参数下存在显著的组织福利损失。
AI.conclusion: 模型给出了中心化、联邦式和混合治理各自占优的模型内条件；识别了影响实施的信息不对称和交易成本；为去中心化数据治理的实证研究提供了形式化基础。

title: Evolution Strategies for Deep RL pretraining
comment: 12 pages, 3 figures, 2 algorithms; EE-568 Reinforcement learning course project
summary: Although Deep Reinforcement Learning has proven highly effective for complex decision-making problems, it demands significant computational resources and careful parameter adjustment in order to develop successful strategies. Evolution strategies offer a more straightforward, derivative-free approach that is less computationally costly and simpler to deploy. However, ES generally do not match the performance levels achieved by DRL, which calls into question their suitability for more demanding scenarios. This study examines the performance of ES and DRL across tasks of varying difficulty, including Flappy Bird, Breakout and Mujoco environments, as well as whether ES could be used for initial training to enhance DRL algorithms. The results indicate that ES do not consistently train faster than DRL. When used as a preliminary training step, they only provide benefits in less complex environments (Flappy Bird) and show minimal or no improvement in training efficiency or stability across different parameter settings when applied to more sophisticated tasks (Breakout and MuJoCo Walker).

AI.tldr: 本文对比了进化策略(ES)与深度强化学习(DRL)在不同难度任务上的表现，并探索ES能否作为DRL的预训练手段。结果表明ES并未普遍快于DRL；ES预训练仅在简单环境(Flappy Bird)中有效，在复杂环境(Breakout、MuJoCo Walker)中无明显提升。
AI.motivation: 深度强化学习虽然效果显著，但计算资源消耗大、参数调优复杂；进化策略作为更简单、免梯度的替代方案，其性能差距尚不明确，且是否能为DRL提供有益的初始训练策略仍有待验证。
AI.method: 在不同难度任务（Flappy Bird、Breakout、MuJoCo Walker）上分别运行ES和DRL算法进行对比；设计实验将ES作为预训练阶段，观察其对后续DRL训练效率的影响。
AI.result: ES在训练速度上并不一致地优于DRL；ES预训练仅在简单环境中带来好处，在复杂任务上对训练效率或稳定性的改善微乎其微甚至没有。
AI.conclusion: ES难以替代DRL用于复杂决策任务，也不适合作为复杂环境下的DRL预训练策略；其简单性优势主要体现在简单场景中。

title: Open, Reliable, and Collective: A Community-Driven Framework for Tool-Using AI Agents
summary: Tool-integrated LLMs can retrieve, compute, and take real-world actions via external tools, but reliability remains a key bottleneck. We argue that failures stem from both tool-use accuracy (how well an agent invokes a tool) and intrinsic tool accuracy (the tool's own correctness), while most prior work emphasizes the former. We introduce OpenTools, a community-driven toolbox that standardizes tool schemas, provides lightweight plug-and-play wrappers, and evaluates tools with automated test suites and continuous monitoring. We also release a public web demo where users can run predefined agents and tools and contribute test cases, enabling reliability reports to evolve as tools change. OpenTools includes the core framework, an initial tool set, evaluation pipelines, and a contribution protocol. Experiments and evaluations show improved end-to-end reproducibility and task performance; community-contributed, higher-quality task-specific tools deliver 6%-22% relative gains over an existing toolbox across multiple agent architectures on downstream tasks and benchmarks, highlighting the importance of intrinsic tool accuracy.

AI.tldr: OpenTools是一个社区驱动的工具箱框架，通过标准化工具模式、提供即插即用包装器、自动化测试和持续监控来解决工具集成LLM的可靠性问题。强调工具内在准确性（工具本身的正确性）与工具使用准确性（智能体调用工具的能力）同样重要，社区贡献的高质量工具在多个智能体架构上实现6%-22%的相对提升。
AI.motivation: 工具集成LLM可通过外部工具实现检索、计算和真实世界操作，但可靠性仍是关键瓶颈。现有工作大多关注"工具使用准确性"（智能体如何调用工具），而忽视了"工具内在准确性"（工具本身是否正确）这一同等重要的问题。
AI.method: 提出OpenTools框架，包含：(1) 标准化工具模式定义；(2) 轻量级即插即用包装器；(3) 自动化测试套件与持续监控机制；(4) 公开Web演示平台供用户运行预定义智能体和工具，并贡献测试用例，使可靠性报告随工具演变而更新。
AI.result: 实验表明该方法提升了端到端可复现性和任务性能；社区贡献的高质量任务特定工具在多个智能体架构的下游任务和基准测试中，相比现有工具箱获得6%-22%的相对性能提升。
AI.conclusion: 研究强调了工具内在准确性对整体系统可靠性的重要性，社区驱动的持续评估和贡献机制可有效提升工具质量，进而改善LLM智能体的任务表现。

title: MAC-Attention: a Match-Amend-Complete Scheme for Fast and Accurate Attention Computation
summary: Long-context decoding in LLMs is IO-bound: each token re-reads an ever-growing KV cache. Prior accelerations cut bytes via compression, which lowers fidelity, or selection/eviction, which restricts what remains accessible, and both can degrade delayed recall and long-form generation. We introduce MAC-Attention, a fidelity- and access-preserving alternative that accelerates decoding by reusing prior attention computations for semantically similar recent queries. It starts with a match stage that performs pre-RoPE L2 matching over a short local window; an amend stage rectifies the reused attention by recomputing a small band near the match boundary; and a complete stage fuses the rectified results with fresh attention computed on the KV tail through a numerically stable merge. On a match hit, the compute and bandwidth complexity is constant regardless of context length. The method is model-agnostic and composes with IO-aware kernels, paged-KV managers, and MQA/GQA. Across LongBench v2 (120K), RULER (120K), and LongGenBench (16K continuous generation), compared to the latest FlashInfer library, MAC-Attention reduces KV accesses by up to 99%, cuts token generation latency by over 60% at 128K, and achieves over 14.3x attention-phase speedups, up to 2.6x end-to-end, while maintaining full-attention quality. By reusing computation, MAC-Attention delivers long-context inference that is both fast and faithful. Code is available here: https://github.com/YJHMITWEB/MAC-Attention.git

AI.tldr: MAC-Attention通过复用近期相似查询的先前注意力计算来加速LLM长上下文解码，在不损失保真度和访问完整性的前提下，将KV访问降低99%，在128K上下文时延迟降低60%以上，端到端加速达2.6倍。
AI.motivation: LLM长上下文解码是IO密集型任务，每个token都需要重新读取不断增长的KV缓存。现有的加速方法如压缩（损害保真度）或选择/淘汰（限制可访问性）都会影响延迟召回和长文本生成质量。
AI.method: MAC-Attention包含三个阶段：1）匹配阶段：对短局部窗口进行RoPE前L2匹配；2）修正阶段：重新计算匹配边界附近的小带宽区域；3）完成阶段：通过数值稳定融合将修正结果与KV尾部的新的注意力计算合并。该方法与IO感知内核、分页KV管理器、MQA/GQA兼容。
AI.result: 在LongBench v2 (120K)、RULER (120K)、LongGenBench (16K连续生成)上，相比最新FlashInfer库，MAC-Attention将KV访问降低99%，128K时token生成延迟降低60%以上，注意力阶段加速超过14.3倍，端到端加速达2.6倍，同时保持全注意力质量。
AI.conclusion: MAC-Attention通过计算复用实现了快速且保真的长上下文推理，为LLM长上下文场景提供了一种无需牺牲精度或访问完整性的高效解决方案。

title: Competition and Cooperation of LLM Agents in Games
summary: Large language model (LLM) agents are increasingly deployed in competitive multi-agent settings, raising fundamental questions about whether they converge to equilibria and how their strategic behavior can be characterized. In this paper, we study LLM agent interactions in two standard games: a network resource allocation game and a Cournot competition game. Rather than converging to Nash equilibria, we find that LLM agents tend to cooperate when given multi-round prompts and non-zero-sum context. Chain-of-thought analysis reveals that fairness reasoning is central to this behavior. We propose an analytical framework that captures the dynamics of LLM agent reasoning across rounds and explains these experimental findings.

AI.tldr: 本文研究 LLM 智能体在两类多智能体竞争博弈（Kelly 机制网络资源分配博弈与线性 Cournot 数量竞争博弈）中的策略行为。主要发现：当提示词设定多轮目标并给出"非零和"情境时，LLM 智能体不会收敛到 Nash 均衡，而是通过相互让步/减价走向合作与社会福利最优点；CoT 分析显示公平性推理是其核心驱动。作者提出一个含"信任权重 θ（合作项）"与"稳定项权重 γ（公平/惩罚项）"的合成收益函数，并给出随回合动态演化的状态空间更新方程，用实验数据反演参数以解释合作、报复、宽恕与末期背叛等现象。
AI.motivation: LLM 智能体正被大量部署于经济、能源、交通等竞争性多智能体环境中（如电力市场中的发电机、电池与负荷由 LLM 管理），自然会问：它们是否会收敛到博弈均衡？若收敛，能否刻画其均衡？但已有文献结论零散且矛盾：有的市场因智能体交互导致价格高于竞争均衡，有的实验则显示主流模型行为高度不一致、近似随机而非策略性博弈。其根源不在优化能力——若提示词明确要求"针对效用函数求最优响应"，多数 LLM 都能照做，但这等于剥夺了智能体的策略思考价值，削弱了使用 LLM 智能体的意义。因此本文研究更贴近实践的设定：提示仅要求在时间视界上最大化自身累计净效用，不指定博弈框架，智能体既非完全合作也非完全零和，从而考察 LLM 在非零和多轮情境下是否会自发产生协调（合作）还是走向效率损失的均衡。
AI.method: 环境与博弈：两类同时行动、有限回合 T、目标为累计净效用的多智能体环境——(1) Kelly 比例资源分配博弈：N 个智能体对固定容量 C 的可分资源出价 x_i≥0，按 d_i=x_i/X·C 分配，单价 p=X/C，净收益 π_i=U_i(d_i)−x_i；(2) 线性 Cournot 博弈：价格 p(x)=Σx_i，净收益 π_i=b_i x_i−x_i·Σx_j（b_i 为估值参数）。理论基准：社会最优 x*=argmax Σπ_i 与 Nash 均衡 x^NE；已知自私的价格预期行为分别造成最多 3/4 与至少 33% 的效率损失。部署：Gemini Pro 为基础模型（其他长上下文模型结果类似），每个智能体置于独立会话以避免上下文泄漏，由中心协调器收集行动并反馈市场状态，智能体不知对手数量与其效用。提示设计三档：Myopic（仅优化当轮）、Longer Horizon（多轮累计效用）、Cooperative Play（在多轮目标上叠加"共同降价可同比例保留资源份额却降低成本"的洞察，并给出信号—反应—惩罚策略）。分析工具：CoT 文本分析 + 合成收益建模与状态空间参数辨识。理论框架：定义 V_i=π_i+θ_i Σ_{j≠i} π̂_{i,j} − (γ_i/2)Σ_{j≠i}(x_i−x_j)²，其中 π̂ 为对手收益的估计（CoT 显示 LLM 采用"启发式镜像"，假设 b_j≈b_i）；内部均衡条件为 ∂V_i/∂x_i=0。动态更新规则（由 CoT 逆向工程并拟合经验轨迹得到）：θ_i^(t+1)=max(ε,I)·(τ/T)·exp(−λE^(t))，其中 I 为可观测性指示（开放信息=1，黑盒/仅聚合信息=0）、τ=T−t 为剩余视界、E^(t)=max(0, x_{-i}^(t)−x_{-i}^coop) 为对手正向偏离信号；γ_i^(t+1)=1(Δπ_i≤Ω_max)·1(τ>0)·max(0, ργ_i^(t)+1.0·E^(t)−αA^(t))，含"保持一致的成本"阈值指示、末期惩罚无效指示、比例响应与记忆衰减。实验：对称/非对称 Cournot（b=15，Δb=b1−b2 可变）、资源分配 Pareto 前沿可视化、扰动注入（背叛 x2=5.625、道歉 x2=2.5）、末期回合行为、多智能体可观测性对比（个体动作可见 vs 仅聚合）。
AI.result: 1) 收敛性：Myopic 提示下智能体给出最优响应并收敛到 Nash 均衡；多轮提示下智能体识别重复博弈结构但行动变化缓慢、探索保守；若不告知回合数，则表现为在短视与长期策略间随机插值、导致不稳定，且高度依赖具体模型。2) 合作：给出"协作洞察"提示后，双智能体资源分配实验中出价按比例下调，从远离 Pareto 前沿的 Nash 点逼近并最终稳定在社会福利最大化解（Fig.1）；对称 Cournot（b=15）中 Agent 1 先让步 5.0→4.0（θ₁=0.40），Agent 2 随后降至 4.0（θ₂=0.75），第 5 回合双方收敛到最优 3.75，θ₁=θ₂=1.0，信任通过"相互让步"逐轮建立（Fig.2、Fig.4）。3) 惩罚与宽恕：第 6 回合注入背叛 x₂=5.625，Agent 1 报复至 x₁=5.0，解得 θ₁=0、γ₁=1.0，呈 Tit-for-Tat 惩罚；第 7 回合对方降至 2.5 后 Agent 1 回到 3.75，θ₁=1、γ₁=0，惩罚机制快速关闭以恢复均衡（Fig.3）。4) 末期效应：倒数第二回合轻微背叛至 4.5（θ₁=0.6），最后一回合打出精确最优响应 5.25（θ₂=0, γ₂=0），表明利他/合作随剩余视界 τ/T 连续衰减，当无未来合作可维持时社会偏好被完全丢弃。5) 信息结构：多智能体情形与双智能体类似，但仅提供聚合动作（总量）时智能体无法内化"总和即充分统计量"，行为变得不规律，接近不了 Pareto 前沿，说明公平性被内建于 LLM，并非严格理性。6) 相变：估值对称度较高时代理压制短视最优响应、保持对称；Δb 较大时代理转向各自最优响应、不对称行动，合作与自私行为之间出现突变式相变。7) 不对称时 θ 与 γ 会把均衡推到 Pareto 前沿上另一个点，作用类似但精度远低于标准公平测度。
AI.conclusion: LLM 智能体在多轮目标与非零和情境下表现出系统性的合作倾向，而非收敛到 Nash 均衡，其驱动机制在很大程度上是 CoT 中可见的公平/互惠推理；作者给出的"合成收益函数 + 动态参数学习"框架能够解释信任建立、背叛惩罚、道歉宽恕、末期退行、信息可观测性影响与对称性相变等现象，为分析 LLM 智能体的策略动力学提供了可推广的解析工具，可望扩展到更广泛的博弈与工程场景。作者同时承认结论对提示词、情境设定与具体模型敏感；未来工作包括刻画合作与竞争行为何时涌现的条件，以及检验结果对模型与提示的鲁棒性与敏感性。

title: Terminal Agents Suffice for Enterprise Automation
summary: There has been growing interest in building agents that can interact with digital platforms to execute meaningful enterprise tasks autonomously. Among the approaches explored are tool-augmented agents built on abstractions such as Model Context Protocol (MCP) and web agents that operate through graphical interfaces. Yet, it remains unclear whether such complex agentic systems are necessary given their cost and operational overhead. We argue that a coding agent equipped only with a terminal and a filesystem can solve many enterprise tasks more effectively by interacting directly with platform APIs. We evaluate this hypothesis across diverse real-world systems and show that these low-level terminal agents match or outperform more complex agent architectures. Our findings suggest that simple programmatic interfaces, combined with strong foundation models, are sufficient for practical enterprise automation.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨企业任务自动化中不同智能体架构的优劣，提出配备终端和文件系统的简单编程式智能体（低层级终端智能体）能够匹配或超越复杂的多层级智能体架构（如MCP工具增强型智能体、GUI网页智能体），认为基础模型结合简单程序化接口足以满足企业自动化需求。
AI.motivation: 当前复杂企业任务自动化主要依赖两种方案：(1) 基于模型上下文协议(MCP)等抽象的工具增强型智能体；(2) 通过图形界面操作的网页智能体。然而，这些系统存在高昂成本和运营开销，研究者质疑复杂架构的必要性，寻求更高效的替代方案。
AI.method: 作者团队构建了仅配备终端和文件系统的低层级编程式智能体，通过直接调用平台API完成各类企业任务，并在多个真实系统中进行了对比评估实验。
AI.result: 实验结果表明，这种低层级终端智能体在企业任务执行中能够匹配甚至超越更复杂的智能体架构。
AI.conclusion: 简单程序化接口结合强大的基础模型足以支撑实际企业自动化场景，无需依赖复杂的多层级智能体抽象架构。

title: Inference-Aware & Privacy-Preserving Deletion in Databases
comment: Accepted in Data Management, Privacy, and Security (SeQureDB), SIGMOD 2026
summary: Deletion is a fundamental database operation, yet modern systems often fail to provide the privacy guarantee that users expect from it. A deleted value may disappear from query results and even from physical storage, yet remain inferable from dependencies, derived data, or traces exposed by the deletion event itself. Meaningful deletion, therefore, requires more than logical removal or physical erasure; it requires a privacy guarantee that limits what remains inferable after deletion. In this paper, we take an inference-centric view of deletion, focusing on two leakage channels: leakage from the post-deletion state and leakage from the deletion pattern itself. We use this lens to distinguish logical, physical, and semantic deletion, organize the design space of deletion operations, and highlight open research challenges for building deletion mechanisms with meaningful privacy guarantees in database systems.

AI.tldr: 本文从推理角度重新审视数据库删除操作，识别两种隐私泄露渠道（删除后状态泄露和删除模式泄露），并以此区分逻辑删除、物理删除和语义删除，为构建具有有意义隐私保障的删除机制提供设计空间和研究方向。
AI.motivation: 现代数据库系统无法提供用户期望的删除隐私保障——数据值可能从查询结果和物理存储中消失，但仍可通过依赖关系、派生数据或删除事件本身暴露的痕迹被推断出来。传统的逻辑删除或物理擦除不足以实现"有意义删除"。
AI.method: 采用推理中心视角，分析两个泄露通道：删除后状态的泄露（数据间依赖关系导致的信息残留）和删除模式的泄露（删除操作本身暴露的信息）。
AI.result: 提出语义删除的概念，区分了逻辑删除、物理删除和语义删除三个层次，并系统性地组织了删除操作的设计空间。
AI.conclusion: 为数据库系统中构建具有有意义隐私保障的删除机制指明了开放的研究挑战和未来方向。

title: Temporal Memory for Resource-Constrained Agents: Continual Learning via Stochastic Compress-Add-Smooth
summary:
An agent that operates sequentially must incorporate new experience without forgetting old experience, under a fixed memory budget. We propose a framework in which memory is not a parameter vector but a stochastic process: a Bridge Diffusion on a replay interval $[0,1]$, whose terminal marginal encodes the present and whose intermediate marginals encode the past. New experience is incorporated via a three-step \emph{Compress--Add--Smooth} (CAS) recursion. We test the framework on the class of models with marginal probability densities modeled via Gaussian mixtures of fixed number of components~$K$ in $d$ dimensions; temporal complexity is controlled by a fixed number~$L$ of piecewise-linear protocol segments whose nodes store Gaussian-mixture states. The entire recursion costs $O(LKd^2)$ flops per day -- no backpropagation, no stored data, no neural networks -- making it viable for controller-light hardware.
  Forgetting in this framework arises not from parameter interference but from lossy temporal compression: the re-approximation of a finer protocol by a coarser one under a fixed segment budget. We find that the retention half-life scales linearly as $a_{1/2}\approx c\,L$ with a constant $c>1$ that depends on the dynamics but not on the mixture complexity~$K$, the dimension~$d$, or the geometry of the target family. The constant~$c$ admits an information-theoretic interpretation analogous to the Shannon channel capacity. The stochastic process underlying the bridge provides temporally coherent ``movie'' replay -- compressed narratives of the agent's history, demonstrated visually on an MNIST latent-space illustration. The framework provides a fully analytical ``Ising model'' of continual learning in which the mechanism, rate, and form of forgetting can be studied with mathematical precision.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 Compress–Add–Smooth (CAS) 持续学习框架：把智能体的记忆表示为回放区间 [0,1] 上的随机过程——桥式扩散 (Bridge Diffusion)，终值边缘分布编码"现在"，中间时刻边缘分布编码"过去"。新一天经验通过"压缩(无损)→加入(非破坏)→平滑(有损重分箱)"三步递归并入固定大小的协议网格。在 K 分量高斯混合 (GM) 实例化下,每天仅需 O(LKd²) 浮点运算,无反向传播、无存储数据、无神经网络,可在微控制器上运行。核心发现:遗忘源于有损时间压缩而非参数干扰;保留半衰期随分段预算线性标度 a_{1/2} ≈ c·L(c ≈ 2.4,且与 K、d、几何无关),常数 c 可类比香农信道容量;失效模式是"混淆"而非"破坏";协议网格可解码为时间连贯的"电影"式回放。
AI.motivation: 在固定内存预算下,顺序学习的智能体(楼宇控制器、机器人、传感器节点)必须吸收新经验而不遗忘旧经验。现有持续学习(CL)方法把记忆表示为神经网络参数,通过正则化(EWC、SI)、回放缓冲区(含基于去噪扩散模型的生成式回放)、或架构扩展(Progressive Nets、Progress & Compress)来缓解灾难性干扰/灾难性遗忘。但这些方法依赖梯度训练、存储数据和算力,难以在边缘/微控制器级硬件上部署。此外,神经CL框架中遗忘机制与速率难以被精确解析研究(缺乏可解的"Ising模型")。本文因此提出:把记忆从"参数向量"改为"随机过程",遗忘归因于可定位的单一机制(时间粗粒化),从而获得可精确数学分析的持续学习理论。
AI.method: 核心对象:在固定回放区间 [0,1] 上维护桥式扩散 (BD),由 L+1 个节点(均匀网格 {j/L})构成的协议 (protocol),每个节点存储一个 K 分量高斯混合 (权重 π_k、均值 m_k、协方差 Σ_k);相邻节点间用 GM 参数的分段线性插值定义密度(权重和保持 1、协方差由凸性保持正定)。另维护先验 q^(0) 与读出时间字典 {t_{m|n}}。每日更新为三步 CAS 递归:(1) 压缩——无损,把 [0,1] 重标定为 [0, L/(L+1)],节点状态不变,旧读出时间乘以 L/(L+1);(2) 加入——非破坏,在新区间 [L/(L+1),1] 上以线性插值接入新一天目标 q^(n+1),得到 L+1 段;(3) 平滑(重分箱)——唯一有损步骤,把 (L+1) 段细网格通过在粗网格上求值插值近似为 L 段,等价于一次稀疏矩阵 W(每行至多两个非零、每行和为 1)与 GM 参数的矩阵-向量乘。遗忘机制由 Remark 1 给出:每次重分箱把节点状态替换为邻居凸组合,左侧(更老)节点被更多次模糊化,均值向共同平均收缩、协方差膨胀、权重对比减弱。度量:原始矩失配 F = ‖μ_replay−μ_orig‖² + ‖Σ_replay−Σ_orig‖_F²;以"完全遗忘基线" F_amnesia 归一化得 F̄(>1 表示 confusion);按年龄 a = n−m 平均得 F̄(a);保留半衰期 a_{1/2} = min{a : F̄(a) ≥ 0.5};K>1 时经匈牙利匹配分解为 F_mean + F_cov + F_weight。附录 A 由 Fokker–Planck 方程反解 SDE 漂移(常数权重有显式解;时变权重需解 Poisson 方程得修正电流),用于生成样本路径。实验:K=1 (d=2, 圆形/线性漂移)、K=3 (旋转等边三角形)、拥挤比 χ=r/σ 扫描、维度 d=2~30 扫描、分裂-合并课程、MNIST 三类数字(0/3/8)的 d=12 PCA 潜空间 + 权重旋转课程 (P=30)。
AI.result: (1) 两段式遗忘曲线:近期低误差平台 + 陡峭 S 形跃迁,半衰期为自然汇总统计量。(2) 线性标度 a_{1/2} ≈ 2.4 L(L=5→14,L=30→74),比 FIFO 缓冲 (a_{1/2}=L) 优约 2.4 倍;解析式 a_{1/2} ≈ L·ln(1/t_*)(t_* ≈ 0.09),c 类比信道容量,给出 a_{1/2} ≤ c_opt(v)·L 的猜想。(3) 与 K(1,2,3,5,8)、d(≤30)、拥挤几何、甚至拓扑课程(合并/分裂/坍缩)均无关;半衰期平坦,课程变化下仍为 30。(4) 漂移速度调制 c(快漂移 ≈2.0,慢漂移 ≈3.6);漂移几何只影响曲线形状(线性 a_{1/2}=42 干净单调,圆形 30 且弱非单调)。(5) 失效模式是混淆(旧记忆向近期era坍缩, F̄>1,可达 1.08~1.12)而非破坏(回到先验)。(6) 通道自适应分解:均值漂移时 F_mean 占 ~85-90%,仅权重变化时协方差主导(MNIST),等权混合的权重误差为机器精度量级(~1e-17)。(7) MNIST:a_{1/2}=37(同 L、P 下合成实验为 21),无混淆过冲,大年龄处遗忘曲线呈周期 P=30 的共振振荡;d=4~30 半衰期平坦(~37),无"语义坍缩"临界维度。(8) 协议网格逐帧解码为"电影",三类数字身份在整个 0→1 区间保持可辨,仅锐度/对比度下降;权重轨迹 t≈0.4 峰为数字 0、t≈0.2 峰为数字 3、t=1 处数字 8 主导。(9) 成本:每日更新 O(LKd²),回放查询 O(Kd²),存储 O(Kd²L)(d=8,K=3,L=20 约 37 kB);SDE 积分仅在需要样本路径时按需执行。
AI.conclusion: CAS 框架给出了一个无需梯度、无需数据存储、无需神经网络的持续学习时间记忆:遗忘被定位到唯一可辨识步骤(重分箱导致的时间粗粒化),并给出可解析的速率律 a_{1/2} ≈ c·L,且 c 与状态空间复杂度无关——即约束遗忘的是时间预算 L 与时间分辨率,而非表征容量。作者将此视为持续学习的"可解 Ising 模型",并与 Shannon 噪声信道编码定理/率失真理论建立类比。后续方向:(i) 通过非均匀(对数)网格、变分重分箱、Wasserstein 测地线等优化提升 c,确定理论上界 c_opt;(ii) 推广到归一化流、基于分数的模型等神经密度族;(iii) 应用到电力系统 24 小时概率密度记忆、拉格朗日湍流从小尺度到大尺度的持续学习;(iv) 用 SDE 回放为基于模型的强化学习生成离线时序连贯轨迹,并类比海马体睡眠回放(协议=突触基质,SDE 积分=回放回合,扩散噪声=回放间变异),对应清醒/睡眠的计算成本分离。

title: A Safety-Aware Role-Orchestrated Multi-Agent LLM Framework for Behavioral Health Communication Simulation
summary: Single-agent large language model (LLM) systems struggle to simultaneously support diverse conversational functions and maintain safety in behavioral health communication. We propose a safety-aware, role-orchestrated multi-agent LLM framework designed to simulate supportive behavioral health dialogue through coordinated, role-differentiated agents. Conversational responsibilities are decomposed across specialized agents, including empathy-focused, action-oriented, and supervisory roles, while a prompt-based controller dynamically activates relevant agents and enforces continuous safety auditing. Using semi-structured interview transcripts from the DAIC-WOZ corpus, we evaluate the framework with scalable proxy metrics capturing structural quality, functional diversity, and computational characteristics. Results illustrate clear role differentiation, coherent inter-agent coordination, and predictable trade-offs between modular orchestration, safety oversight, and response latency when compared to a single-agent baseline. This work emphasizes system design, interpretability, and safety, positioning the framework as a simulation and analysis tool for behavioral health informatics and decision-support research rather than a clinical intervention.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个安全感知、角色编排的多智能体LLM框架，通过角色分解（共情、行动、监督）与基于提示的动态激活控制器，配合持续安全审计，模拟支持性的行为健康对话；基于DAIC-WOZ半结构化访谈数据用代理指标评估，表现出清晰的角色分化、协调一致性与模块化/安全/延迟之间的可预测权衡，定位为行为健康信息学的仿真与分析工具而非临床干预。
AI.motivation: 单智能体LLM系统在行为健康沟通中存在两方面难以兼顾的问题：一方面需要支持多样的会话功能（情感共情、信息提供、行动建议、引导等），另一方面又难以在长程、多轮交互中持续维持安全性与一致性。将所有对话职责与安全约束堆叠在单一提示中，会导致角色混淆、功能冗余、响应质量不稳定，并使安全审计难以独立进行。此外，行为健康领域研究通常缺乏可控、可复现的对话仿真手段以支持系统设计与评估，因此需要一个可解释、模块化、可审计的模拟与分析平台。
AI.method: 1) 框架设计：安全感知 + 角色编排的多智能体LLM架构。将对话职责分解为若干专门智能体，包括以共情为导向（empathy-focused）的角色、以行动为导向（action-oriented）的角色以及监督/审查（supervisory）角色，各角色具有独立提示与职责边界。2) 编排机制：基于提示的控制器（prompt-based controller）动态判断当前轮次应激活哪些相关智能体，实现按需调用而非固定流水线；监督角色执行持续的安全审计（continuous safety auditing），对生成内容进行检查与拦截/修正。3) 评估数据：使用DAIC-WOZ语料库的半结构化访谈转录文本作为真实对话场景输入，构造行为健康对话的模拟情境。4) 评估方法：由于真实部署条件下LLM-as-judge等评估成本高昂且难以大规模复现，作者采用可扩展的代理指标（scalable proxy metrics），从三个维度刻画系统输出与运行特性——结构质量（structural quality，如轮次结构、角色分工的可辨识度）、功能多样性（functional diversity，即不同会话功能与不同角色贡献的覆盖与差异性）、计算特征（computational characteristics，如token消耗、调用次数、响应延迟）。5) 基线对照：与单智能体基线（single-agent baseline）在同一数据与场景下比较，以量化角色分化程度、智能体间协调一致性，以及模块化编排、安全监督与响应延迟三者之间的权衡关系。
AI.result: 结果以定性描述为主：框架展现出清晰的角色分化（各智能体输出具有可区分的功能特征与风格）、连贯的智能体间协调（控制器激活与角色交接自然、上下文传递一致）、以及可预测的权衡——相比单智能体基线，多智能体编排带来结构与功能多样性提升，但伴随额外的计算开销与响应延迟增加，安全监督的加入进一步拉高成本，而延迟与安全强度之间存在可调节的取舍曲线。作者同时强调代理指标作为可扩展评估手段的实用价值，以及框架在可解释性与安全审计方面的增益。
AI.conclusion: 该工作强调系统设计、接口可解释性与安全属性，主张将多智能体框架定位为行为健康信息学与决策支持研究中的仿真与分析工具，而非直接的临床干预手段。其贡献在于：提供一个角色分工明确、动态编排、可持续安全审计的LLM多智能体架构原型，配套可扩展的代理评估指标体系，用于在无需真实临床部署的条件下研究行为健康对话系统的结构性特征、功能覆盖与成本-安全-延迟权衡。局限在于评估主要依赖DAIC-WOZ访谈转录构造的模拟情境与代理指标，缺少真实用户或临床专家验证，安全性结论依赖提示级审计而非形式化保证，未来需在更真实场景、更严格指标与人工评估下验证并量化安全-延迟权衡的精确边界。

title: Scalable Pretraining of Large Mixture of Experts Language Models on Aurora Super Computer
summary: Pretraining Large Language Models (LLMs) from scratch requires massive amount of compute. Aurora super computer is an ExaScale machine with 127,488 Intel PVC (Ponte Vechio) GPU tiles. In this work, we showcase LLM pretraining on Aurora at the scale of 1000s of GPU tiles. Towards this effort, we developed Optimus, an inhouse training library with support for standard large model training techniques. Using Optimus, we first pretrained Mula-1B, a 1 Billion dense model and Mula-7B-A1B, a 7 Billion Mixture of Experts (MoE) model from scratch on 3072 GPU tiles for the full 4 trillion tokens of the OLMoE-mix-0924 dataset. We then demonstrated model scaling by pretraining three large MoE models Mula-20B-A2B, Mula-100B-A7B, and Mula-220B-A10B till 100 Billion tokens on the same dataset. On our largest model Mula-220B-A10B, we pushed the compute scaling from 384 to 12288 GPU tiles and observed scaling efficiency of around 90% at 12288 GPU tiles. We significantly improved the runtime performance of MoE models using custom GPU kernels for expert computation, and a novel EP-Aware sharded optimizer resulting in training speedups up to 1.71x. As part of the Optimus library, we also developed a robust set of reliability and fault tolerant features to improve training stability and continuity at scale.

AI.tldr: 本文介绍了在Aurora超算（127,488块Intel PVC GPU）上使用Optimus训练库从零开始预训练LLM的工作。成功训练了1B dense模型和多个MoE模型（7B-220B），最大规模达12288 GPU tiles，扩展效率约90%，并通过自定义GPU内核和EP-Aware分片优化器实现MoE模型1.71x训练加速。
AI.motivation: 从头预训练LLM需要海量算力，本文旨在展示在Aurora超算上实现千GPU级别的大规模LLM预训练能力，解决超大规模分布式训练的效率、可靠性和容错问题。
AI.method: 开发Optimus训练库，支持标准大模型训练技术；使用3072-12288 GPU tiles进行预训练；采用自定义GPU内核加速MoE专家计算；设计EP-Aware分片优化器；在OLMoE-mix-0924数据集上训练。
AI.result: 成功预训练Mula-1B（dense）和多个MoE模型至7B/20B/100B/220B规模；12288 GPU tiles下扩展效率约90%；MoE模型训练加速达1.71x。
AI.conclusion: Aurora超算能够高效支持千亿参数级别LLM的预训练，Optimus库提供了可靠的分布式训练解决方案，MoE架构配合定制优化可实现接近线性扩展。

title: GRASP: Gradient Realignment via Active Shared Perception for Multi-Agent Collaborative Optimization
summary: Non-stationarity arises from concurrent policy updates and leads to persistent environmental fluctuations. Existing approaches like Centralized Training with Decentralized Execution (CTDE) and sequential update schemes mitigate this issue. However, since the perception of the policies of other agents remains dependent on sampling environmental interaction data, the agent essentially operates in a passive perception state. This inevitably triggers equilibrium oscillations and significantly slows the convergence speed of the system. To address this issue, we propose Gradient Realignment via Active Shared Perception (GRASP), a novel framework that defines generalized Bellman equilibrium as a stable objective for policy evolution. The core mechanism of GRASP involves utilizing the independent gradients of agents to derive a defined consensus gradient, enabling agents to actively perceive policy updates and optimize team collaboration. Theoretically, we leverage the Kakutani Fixed-Point Theorem to prove that the consensus direction $u^*$ guarantees the existence and attainability of this equilibrium. Extensive experiments on StarCraft II Multi-Agent Challenge (SMAC) and Google Research Football (GRF) demonstrate the scalability and promising performance of the framework.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 GRASP（Gradient Realignment via Active Shared Perception）框架，将多智能体协作优化的目标显式定义为「广义 Bellman 均衡」，并通过在各智能体独立梯度的凸包中求解最小范数向量（QP 形式）得到共识梯度 u*，将其注入 PPO 更新方向实现「梯度重对齐」，使智能体从被动感知他人策略更新转变为主动感知。基于 Kakutani 不动点定理证明均衡点的存在性与可达性，并在 SMAC、SMACv2、GRF、MPE 上取得优于 MAPPO/HAPPO/MA²E 的样本效率与最终胜率。
AI.motivation: 多智能体强化学习（MARL）中，智能体并发更新策略使彼此成为环境的一部分，导致非平稳性。现有 CTDE 范式（如 MADDPG、VDN、QMIX）通过集中式 Critic/Mixer 稳定价值估计，但分散式 Actor 仍在漂移的联合策略空间中「盲目」更新，未解决策略层面的动态干扰；时序化方法（HAPPO 的顺序更新、ACE 的顺序决策）仅提供碎片化、不连续的局部平稳性。共同局限在于「被动感知」：智能体只能靠重新采样环境交互数据来推断他人策略变化，速度慢且滞后，导致均衡振荡、收敛速度显著下降。论文据此提出核心问题：能否显式定义一个可被所有智能体共同感知的稳定优化目标（共识方向），使局部更新与全局团队目标一致。
AI.method: 形式化：以 Dec-POMDP/随机博弈建模 N 智能体共享奖励的团队目标 J(θ)，定义最优协作策略 π*（最大化团队回报而非个体最优）与共识算子 f: {g_1,…,g_N} → u*，更新规则 π_i^{(t)} = π_i^{(t-1)} + u^{(t)} + g_i^{(t)}。给出共识梯度算子应满足的三条性质（Condition 3.4）：帕累托改进性质 g_i^T u* ≥ 0、连续性、共识表示性（u* 位于局部梯度凸包内）；并指出 u*=0 即为「广义 Bellman 均衡」（不存在可同时提升所有智能体回报的联合策略改进方向）。构造实现：以 MAPPO 为骨干（GRASP-MAPPO），三步 Actor 更新——(1) 各智能体用全局 GAE 优势计算局部策略梯度 g_i；(2) 解 QP 求凸包内最小范数共识梯度 u* = Σ c_i* g_i，约束 c ∈ Δ_N（MGDA/Frank-Wolfe 风格，Gram 矩阵 P_ij = g_i^T g_j）；(3) 梯度重对齐，把 u* 作为线性正则项注入 PPO clipped 目标：θ_new = argmax(J_PPO(θ) + ⟨θ, u*⟩)，即 Δθ_i = ∇J_i^PPO + u*，同时 PPO 概率比裁剪仍约束在信任域内；Critic 用带裁剪的 MSE 回归 R̂_t = Â_t + V(s_t;φ_old)。理论分析：把多智能体学习建模为信任域约束的共识优化问题（TRCCO），用一阶泰勒展开与最小范数凸包几何性质证明 ΔJ ≥ ηΣ||g_i||² + ηΣ⟨g_i,u*⟩ ≥ 0，再由策略改进定理与递归展开证明 V^π_new ≥ V^π_old；用 Kakutani 不动点定理验证更新映射 T_GRASP(θ)=θ+η(g(θ)+u*(θ)) 的非空性、凸性、闭图（借助 Berge 最大定理证明 u*(θ) 连续），从而保证存在共识均衡不动点 θ*；KKT 条件证明 λ = ||u*||² 且 g_j^T u* = ||u*||² + μ_j ≥ 0。离策略扩展（附录G）：引入几何对齐因子 Γ_i = (||u*||²+⟨g_i,u*⟩)/(||g_i||²+||u*||²) ∈ [0,1] 缩放更新幅度，保证个体改进与集体一致性。
AI.result: SMAC：GRASP-MAPPO 在 MMM2（0.967±0.031）、3s5z_vs_3s6z（0.783±0.360）、5m_vs_6m（0.909±0.044）均显著优于 MAPPO/HAPPO/MA²E；SMACv2 多数场景领先（10gen_terran 略逊于 MA²E）；超难 27m_vs_30m 中 MAPPO 成功率 94.68%，GRASP 提升至 96.97%（失败率相对下降约 43%）。GRF 三个场景（Counterattack Hard、3v1 with Keeper、Academy Corner 11 智能体）均表现出更快收敛与更高渐近胜率，可突破基线的次优瓶颈；MPE Simple Spread 在同等训练步数下收敛到更优策略（加性奖励、需避免冲突干扰）。可扩展性方面，GRASP 亦可移植于离策略方法（GRASP-QMIX 提升 QMIX，但因回放缓冲区陈旧转移导致共识效果弱于 MAPPO）；网络采用共享特征骨干+独立策略头的混合架构以降低多智能体梯度计算开销。
AI.conclusion: GRASP 通过共识梯度实现了「主动共享感知」，为 MARL 非平稳性提供了显式、可达的稳定目标（广义 Bellman 均衡），理论上由 Kakutani 不动点定理保证均衡点的存在与可达、由泰勒展开与策略改进定理保证单调改进与价值函数收敛，实践上以框架形式可插接到 MAPPO/QMIX 等 CTDE 方法，在多环境上获得更优的样本效率与渐近性能。主要局限：本质上偏好在策略参数空间构造共识梯度，计算共识梯度需要各智能体独立的参数梯度，在完全参数共享架构下计算代价与显存开销显著上升，故作者采用共享骨干、独立策略头的折中设计；此外在高随机环境中梯度方差增大导致凸包膨胀、共识梯度范数被稀释，使共识收益衰减。作者提出未来方向为融合表示与梯度的混合共识算子，以提升极端随机性下的鲁棒估计能力。

title: An Empirical Study on How Architectural Topology Affects Microservice Performance and Energy Usage
summary: Microservice architectures form the backbone of modern software systems for their scalability, resilience, and maintainability, but their rise in cloud-native environments raises energy efficiency concerns. While prior research addresses microservice decomposition and placement, the impact of topology, the structural arrangement and interaction pattern among services, on energy efficiency remains largely underexplored. This study quantifies the impact of topologies on energy efficiency and performance across six canonical ones (Sequential Fan-Out, Parallel Fan-Out, Chain, Hierarchical, Probabilistic, Mesh), each instantiated at 5-, 10-, and 20-service scales using the $μ\text{Bench}$ framework. We measure throughput, response time, energy usage, CPU utilization, and failure rates under an identical workload. The results indicate that topology influences the energy efficiency of microservices under the studied conditions. As system size increases, energy consumption grows, with the steepest rise observed in dense Mesh and Chain topologies. Mesh topologies perform worst overall, with low throughput, long response times, and high failure rates. Hierarchical, Chain, and Fan-Out designs balance performance and energy use better. As systems scale, metrics converge, with Probabilistic and Parallel Fan-Out emerging as the most energy-efficient under CPU-bound loads. These results guide greener microservice architecture design and serve as a baseline for future research on workload and deployment impacts.

AI.tldr: 该研究使用μBench框架，在5、10、20服务规模下测试了6种典型微服务拓扑（顺序扇出、并行扇出、链式、分层、概率、网格）的能源效率，发现拓扑结构对能源效率有显著影响，其中Mesh拓扑性能最差，而分层、链式和扇出设计能更好地平衡性能和能耗，随着系统规模扩大，指标趋于收敛。
AI.motivation: 微服务架构虽具可扩展性和弹性，但云原生环境下的能源效率问题日益突出。尽管现有研究关注微服务的分解和部署策略，但拓扑结构（即服务间的结构排列和交互模式）对能源效率的影响尚未得到充分探索。
AI.method: 使用μBench框架构建6种标准拓扑结构（顺序扇出、并行扇出、链式、分层、概率、网格），每种拓扑在5、10、20服务规模下进行测试，在相同工作负载下测量吞吐量、响应时间、能源消耗、CPU利用率和故障率。
AI.result: 拓扑结构影响微服务能源效率；随系统规模增大，能源消耗增长，Mesh和链式拓扑增长最陡；Mesh拓扑整体性能最差（低吞吐量、长响应时间、高故障率）；分层、链式、扇出设计能更好平衡性能和能耗；系统扩展时指标趋于收敛，概率和并行扇出在CPU受限负载下最节能。
AI.conclusion: 研究结果为绿色微服务架构设计提供指导，并为未来工作负载和部署影响研究提供基准。研究确认了拓扑设计选择对能源效率的重要性。

title: Making Array-Based Translation Practical for Modern, High-Performance Buffer Management
summary:
Modern buffer pools must now support a broader workload mix than classic OLTP alone. In addition to B-tree lookups, database systems increasingly serve scan-heavy analytics and vector-search indexes with irregular high-fan-out graph traversal access patterns. These workloads require a translation mechanism -- mapping logical page IDs to resident frames -- that is simultaneously fast across these diverse access patterns, deployable in user space,compatible with huge pages, easy to integrate, and still under DBMS control for eviction and I/O. Existing designs satisfy only subsets of these goals.
  This paper presents \textbf{\calico}, a practical DBMS-controlled buffer pool built around array-based translation, a decades-old-idea that was dissmissed but now viable with modern hardware.
  \calico decouples logical translation from OS page tables so that the DBMS can combine low-overhead translation with huge-page-backed frames and fine-grained page management. To make array translation practical and performant for DBMSes with large sparse hierarchical page identifiers, \calico introduces three techniques: multi-level translation with path caching, hole punching for reclaiming cold translation memory, and group prefetch to exploit parallelism.
  Our evaluation across scans, OLTP-style B-tree accesses, and vector search shows that \calico matches or outperforms the existing state-of-the-art in-memory and out-of-memory performance. We also implement \calico as a drop-in replacement for PostgreSQL's buffer manager and integrate it with \texttt{pgvector}. Across vector search, and scan-heavy workloads, \calico delivers up to 3.9$\times$ in-memory and 6.5$\times$ larger-than-memory speedup for PostgreSQL vector search, speeds up scan-heavy queries by up to 3$\times$.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Calico，一个基于数组翻译的实用数据库缓冲池管理系统，可同时支持OLTP、扫描密集型分析和向量搜索等多样化工作负载，实现高达3.9倍内存性能和6.5倍超出内存性能提升，已集成到PostgreSQL中。
AI.motivation: 现代数据库系统需要支持比传统OLTP更广泛的工作负载，包括扫描密集型分析和不规则高扇出图遍历访问模式的向量搜索索引。现有缓冲池设计仅能满足快速翻译、用户空间部署、巨页兼容、易集成和DBMS控制等目标的子集，无法同时满足所有需求。
AI.method: Calico采用基于数组的翻译机制，将逻辑翻译与OS页表解耦，使DBMS能够结合低开销翻译与巨页支持以及细粒度页面管理。为使数组翻译适用于具有大型稀疏分层页面标识符的DBMS，Calico引入了三种技术：带路径缓存的多级翻译、用于回收冷翻译内存的空洞打孔，以及利用并行性的组预取。
AI.result: 在扫描、OLTP风格B树访问和向量搜索等工作负载下的评估表明，Calico在内存和超出内存场景下均可达到或超越现有最优方案的性能水平。
AI.conclusion: 作为PostgreSQL缓冲管理器的直接替代方案，Calico与pgvector集成后，在向量搜索工作负载下实现了最高3.9倍的内存内加速和6.5倍的超出内存加速，扫描密集型查询加速最高达3倍。

title: Perspective: Towards sustainable exploration of chemical spaces with machine learning
summary: Artificial intelligence is transforming molecular and materials science, but its growing computational and data demands raise critical sustainability challenges. In this Perspective, we examine resource considerations across the AI-driven discovery pipeline--from quantum-mechanical (QM) data generation and model training to automated, self-driving research workflows--building on discussions from the ``SusML workshop: Towards sustainable exploration of chemical spaces with machine learning'' held in Dresden, Germany. In this context, the availability of large quantum datasets has enabled rigorous benchmarking and rapid methodological progress, while also incurring substantial energy and infrastructure costs. We highlight emerging strategies to enhance efficiency, including general-purpose machine learning (ML) models, multi-fidelity approaches, model distillation, and active learning. Moreover, incorporating physics-based constraints within hierarchical workflows, where fast ML surrogates are applied broadly and high-accuracy QM methods are used selectively, can further optimize resource use without compromising reliability. Equally important is bridging the gap between idealized computational predictions and real-world conditions by accounting for synthesizability and multi-objective design criteria, which is essential for practical impact. Finally, we argue that sustainable progress will rely on open data and models, reusable workflows, and domain-specific AI systems that maximize scientific value per unit of computation, enabling efficient and responsible discovery of technological materials and therapeutics.

AI.tldr: 本文是一篇观点性综述（Perspective），以2025年在德国德累斯顿举办的“ SusML workshop: Towards sustainable exploration of chemical spaces with machine learning ”研讨会讨论为基础，系统审视AI驱动化学空间探索全流程（量子力学数据生成 → 模型训练 → 自动化自驱动实验室）中的资源消耗与可持续性问题。作者指出大规模量子数据集虽推动了严格基准测试与方法学进步，但也带来高昂的能源与基础设施成本；应对策略包括通用/基础ML模型、多保真（multi-fidelity）方法、模型蒸馏、主动学习、在分层工作流中嵌入物理约束（快速ML代理广泛使用、高精度QM选择性调用）、纳入可合成性与多目标设计判据，并强调开放数据与模型、可复用工作流和领域专用小型AI系统。
AI.motivation: AI正在重塑分子与材料科学，但其自身快速增长的算力与数据需求带来了长期被忽视的环境代价（“AI本身的碳足迹”）：DFT/AIMD等大规模量子模拟与模型训练、尤其是模型复杂度和GPU规模攀升，使每篇论文的用电量呈上升趋势，呈现“杰文斯悖论”——效率提升反而推高总资源消耗（如MOF的CO2储存容量预测中MAE下降28%却带来训练碳足迹增加15000%；马普计算与数据设施年均约37 GWh电力与14.5千吨CO2；Top500超算年运行排放约140万吨CO2e）。同时计算材料学与化学界对“绿色AI”的采纳仍明显落后于通用ML社区，因此需要把生态、社会、经济三维可持续性（SDG框架）引入化学空间的智能探索这一“绿AI”议程。
AI.method: 方法上为多作者协作的观点/立场文章而非定量研究：作者们按AI发现流水线组织综述性论述，每个子节先综述现状、再以“Open challenges”列出未解问题。结构为：(1) 通过增强表示实现可持续性质预测——等变机器学习力场（MLFF）与预训练/通用力场（QM7-X、QM9、ANI、MD17/22、SPICE、Materials Project、Alexandria、OMat24等）、GRACE/ACE等架构、数据高效性与推理成本、张量核与并行化、模型蒸馏；面向药物发现的量子启发表示（QUED框架：DFTB3+MBD电子描述符+Bag of Bonds/SLATM/SOAP几何描述符）与构象采样；材料信息学中的简约模型（SISSO稀疏符号回归，压缩感知式符号回归）；面向非范德华二维材料的数据驱动设计（XCP剥落势、AFLOW-ICSD全库扫描）与强关联体系的高精度电子结构（DMRG、AFQMC、FCI-QMC、神经量子态、量子计算）。(2) 可持续生成与抽取式AI——分子（过渡金属配合物的VAE、扩散模型、遗传算法/PL-MOGA）、无机材料生成（体素密度表示、对称性表示、CIF/矩阵表示与MatterGen；可逆性不变量表示难题与数据泄漏争议）、LLM作为预测工具（PSPP链推理、材料知识基准）与作为抽取工具（MatBERT/MatSciBERT/BatteryBERT等，通过知识蒸馏低成本构建领域BERT，M-PIE、PV600基准）。(3) 采样优化——主动学习与不确定性量化（结构相似性/描述符新颖度、GPR、委员会查询、深度集成、shallow ensemble、dropout）、高成本模拟下的贝叶斯优化（BOSS）、MLIP的数据效率（数据选择、迁移学习/微调、师生式模型蒸馏）、自动化高通量流水线（数据库与OPTIMADE、atomate2、AiiDA、pymatgen/ase、可合成性/无序/非晶/微结构评估）与自驱动实验室（贝叶斯优化的冷启动问题、并行化与数据效率的权衡、函数网络式工作流、类别变量表示）。
AI.result: 综述得出若干具体事实与共识：(1) 等变MLFF以较少数据即可高精度学习Born–Oppenheimer势能面，且比非等变模型更数据高效、更准确，并可作为通用/基础模型骨干；但训练开销大、推理成本高（稀疏Clebsch-Gordan张量积与密集GPU不匹配），需专用张量核、域分解/图分割并行与蒸馏缓解。(2) 量子启发描述符能提升ADMET预测的稳健性、解释性与低数据区表现（QUED结合电子与几何信息预测毒性与脂溶性，并可接入MACE、SO3LR等可学习嵌入）；构象系综采样仍是瓶颈。(3) SISSO等稀疏符号学习在稀疏数据区（数十至数百样本）即可给出紧凑可解释解析式（钙钛矿容忍因子修正、硬度与弹性模量、Gibbs自由能、MXene赝电容等），但局部有序结构描述符与物理先验（守恒律、对称性、量纲一致性、渐近行为）的嵌入仍待解决。(4) XCP势从AFLOW-ICSD识别出37,208个可剥离表面/潜在非范德华2D片层，并几乎覆盖所有已实验实现体系，展示了数据高效、物理可解释方法的模板价值。(5) 强关联/多参考体系需要以物理指标（前沿轨道简并、自旋污染、分数轨道占据、纠缠度量、求解器行为）指导分层计算，把昂贵高保真求解器“按需调用”，而非试图整体替代。(6) 生成模型已能高效提出多目标材料（如太阳能、催化剂、低供应链风险材料），但晶体结构的不变且可逆表示仍未解决（GNoME新颖性受质疑、A-Lab多为已知物的无序变体、MatterGen存在训练集数据泄漏），且从计算预测到真实条件（温度、压力、超胞、无序与非晶、缺陷、晶界、可合成性）仍有巨大鸿沟。(7) 领域专用抽取式BERT（MatSciBERT-QA等）在材料性质抽取上可与GPT-4o相当甚至更优，且体积小得多；通过“语料→材料数据库（ChemDataExtractor）→定位句→重写为问答对→微调vanilla BERT”的知识蒸馏路径，可显著降低领域模型的算力与碳成本；建议以小型、开放、领域专用的SLM/agentic工作流替代通用ChatGPT式方案。(8) 主动学习/贝叶斯优化（BOSS、GPR、多任务与人在环）可将采样规模减半并保持性能；MLIP领域迁移学习、预训练+微调（如MatterTune）、师生蒸馏（硅→非晶硅学生模型）被证明有效。(9) 通用方法仍普遍缺乏公认基准，MLIP与通用模型在主动学习流程中的融合尚不充分；自驱动实验室中并行化会降低数据效率，贝叶斯优化的冷启动、类别变量与固定工作流刚性是主要瓶颈。
AI.conclusion: 可持续的化学空间探索应以“单位计算量的科学价值”为评价标准：通用/基础模型的前期算力与能耗投入只有通过开放共享（开放数据、开放权重、可复用的模块化工作流与协同基础设施）才能被摊薄；多保真策略、模型蒸馏与高效推理架构使这些模型能以可承受的成本部署，且在分层工作流中由快速ML代理广泛覆盖、昂贵的QM方法仅在电子结构复杂处选择性调用；把守恒律、对称性、量纲一致性等物理约束嵌入模型构造可同时提升泛化性、可解释性与数据效率；生成式框架必须纳入元素丰度、毒性、可回收性与可合成性等多目标判据，并通过自动化实验室快速验证以闭合“设计—合成—验证”回路；优先发展小型、领域专用、可作为agent嵌入智能体工作流的AI系统，而非默认依赖通用大模型；主动学习、自动化与自适应优化应充分利用先验知识与中间观测以减少仿真与实验次数。作者同时指出，推广到微结构、超材料、内在无序蛋白与生物分子凝聚体等复杂系统仍是重大挑战；随着ML方法成为主流，其成效不仅应看预测精度，还应看其降低计算成本、实验浪费与环境影响的实际能力。

title: Human-in-the-Loop Control of Objective Drift in LLM-Assisted Computer Science Education
summary: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly embedded in computer science education through AI-assisted programming tools, yet such workflows often exhibit objective drift, in which locally plausible outputs diverge from stated task specifications. Existing instructional responses frequently emphasize tool-specific prompting practices, limiting durability as AI platforms evolve. This paper adopts a human-centered stance, treating human-in-the-loop (HITL) control as a stable educational problem rather than a transitional step toward AI autonomy. Drawing on systems engineering and control-theoretic concepts, we frame objectives and world models as operational artifacts that students configure to stabilize AI-assisted work. We propose a pilot undergraduate CS laboratory curriculum that explicitly separates planning from execution and trains students to specify acceptance criteria and architectural constraints prior to code generation. In selected labs, the curriculum also introduces deliberate, concept-aligned drift to support diagnosis and recovery from specification violations. We report a sensitivity power analysis for a three-arm pilot design comparing unstructured AI use, structured planning, and structured planning with injected drift, establishing detectable effect sizes under realistic section-level constraints. The contribution is a theory-driven, methodologically explicit foundation for HITL pedagogy that renders control competencies teachable across evolving AI tools.

AI.tldr: 本文将人机协作（HITL）控制定位为CS教育的核心能力而非AI自动化的过渡阶段，提出基于控制理论的课程框架，通过分离规划与执行、明确验收标准和架构约束来训练学生在AI辅助编程中的控制能力。
AI.motivation: 当前AI辅助编程工具在CS教育中广泛应用，但存在"目标漂移"问题——看似合理的输出可能偏离任务规范。现有教学应对多聚焦于特定工具的提示词技巧，限制了方案的持久性和可迁移性。需要从人类中心视角重新审视AI辅助编程教育。
AI.method: 1. 借鉴系统工程的控制理论概念，将目标和世界模型视为可配置的操作工件；2. 设计本科CS实验课程，明确分离规划与执行阶段；3. 让学生在代码生成前指定验收标准和架构约束；4. 在部分实验中引入"概念对齐的故意漂移"以训练诊断与恢复能力；5. 对三组对照设计（自由AI使用、结构化规划、结构化规划+注入漂移）进行敏感度功效分析。
AI.result: 建立了在现实课程规模约束下可检测效应量的功效分析基础，验证了三臂试点实验设计的可行性。
AI.conclusion: 本文贡献了一个理论驱动、方法论明确的HITL教学框架，使控制能力可跨不同AI工具进行教学，为AI辅助编程教育提供了可持续的教学设计范式。

title: EmbedPart: Embedding-Driven Graph Partitioning for Scalable Graph Neural Network Training
summary: Graph Neural Networks (GNNs) are widely used for learning on graph-structured data, but scaling GNN training to massive graphs remains challenging. To enable scalable distributed training, graphs are divided into smaller partitions that are distributed across multiple machines such that inter-machine communication is minimized and computational load is balanced. In practice, existing partitioning approaches face a fundamental trade-off between partitioning overhead and partitioning quality.
